2746.label: Leviticus 1:1
2746.text: And Jehovah called Moses and spoke to him from the tent of meeting, saying:

2747.label: Leviticus 1:2
2747.text: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them, ‘If any one of you would present an offering to Jehovah from the domestic animals, you should present your offering from the herd or from the flock.

2748.label: Leviticus 1:3
2748.text: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he should present a sound male animal. He should present it of his own free will before Jehovah at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

2749.label: Leviticus 1:4
2749.text: He is to lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it will be accepted in his behalf to make atonement for him.

2750.label: Leviticus 1:5
2750.text: “‘Then the young bull must be slaughtered before Jehovah, and the sons of Aaron, the priests, will present the blood and sprinkle the blood on all sides of the altar, which is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

2751.label: Leviticus 1:6
2751.text: The burnt offering should be skinned and cut into pieces.

2752.label: Leviticus 1:7
2752.text: The sons of Aaron, the priests, are to put fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.

2753.label: Leviticus 1:8
2753.text: The sons of Aaron, the priests, will arrange the pieces of the offering with the head and the suet over the wood that is on the fire on the altar.

2754.label: Leviticus 1:9
2754.text: Its intestines and its shanks will be washed with water, and the priest is to make all of it smoke on the altar as a burnt offering, an offering made by fire of a pleasing aroma to Jehovah.

2755.label: Leviticus 1:10
2755.text: “‘If his offering for a burnt offering is from the flock, from the young rams or the goats, he should present a sound male.

2756.label: Leviticus 1:11
2756.text: It is to be slaughtered at the north side of the altar before Jehovah, and the sons of Aaron, the priests, will sprinkle its blood on all sides of the altar.

2757.label: Leviticus 1:12
2757.text: He will cut it up into pieces, and with its head and its suet, the priest will arrange them over the wood on the fire on the altar.

2758.label: Leviticus 1:13
2758.text: He will wash the intestines and the shanks with water, and the priest will present all of it and make it smoke on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire of a pleasing aroma to Jehovah.

2759.label: Leviticus 1:14
2759.text: “‘However, if he offers birds as a burnt offering to Jehovah, he will present his offering from the turtledoves or the young pigeons.

2760.label: Leviticus 1:15
2760.text: The priest will present it at the altar and nip off its head and make it smoke on the altar, but its blood should be drained out on the side of the altar.

2761.label: Leviticus 1:16
2761.text: He should remove its crop and its feathers and throw them beside the altar, to the east, to the place for the ashes.

2762.label: Leviticus 1:17
2762.text: He will split it at its wings without dividing it into two parts. Then the priest will make it smoke on the altar over the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire of a pleasing aroma to Jehovah.

2763.label: Leviticus 2:1
2763.text: “‘Now if someone presents a grain offering to Jehovah, his offering must be fine flour, and he should pour oil on it and put frankincense on it.

2764.label: Leviticus 2:2
2764.text: Then he will bring it to the sons of Aaron, the priests, and the priest will take a handful of the fine flour and oil and all its frankincense, and he will make it smoke as a token offering on the altar, an offering made by fire of a pleasing aroma to Jehovah.

2765.label: Leviticus 2:3
2765.text: Whatever is left of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons as something most holy from Jehovah’s offerings made by fire.

2766.label: Leviticus 2:4
2766.text: “‘If you present a grain offering that has been baked in the oven, it should be of fine flour, unleavened ring-shaped loaves mixed with oil or unleavened wafers spread with oil.

2767.label: Leviticus 2:5
2767.text: “‘If your offering is a grain offering from the griddle, it should be of fine, unleavened flour mixed with oil.

2768.label: Leviticus 2:6
2768.text: It should be broken into pieces, and you are to pour oil on it. It is a grain offering.

2769.label: Leviticus 2:7
2769.text: “‘If your offering is a grain offering prepared in a pan, it should be made of fine flour with oil.

2770.label: Leviticus 2:8
2770.text: You should bring the grain offering that was made of these to Jehovah, and it will be presented to the priest, who will bring it near to the altar.

2771.label: Leviticus 2:9
2771.text: And the priest will lift off some of the grain offering as a token offering and make it smoke on the altar as an offering made by fire of a pleasing aroma to Jehovah.

2772.label: Leviticus 2:10
2772.text: What is left of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons as something most holy of Jehovah’s offerings by fire.

2773.label: Leviticus 2:11
2773.text: “‘No grain offering that you present to Jehovah should be leavened, for you must not make any sourdough or honey smoke as an offering made by fire to Jehovah.

2774.label: Leviticus 2:12
2774.text: “‘You may present them to Jehovah as an offering of the firstfruits, but they must not be brought to the altar as a pleasing aroma.

2775.label: Leviticus 2:13
2775.text: “‘Every grain offering you make is to be seasoned with salt; and you must not allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be missing from your grain offering. Along with every offering of yours, you will present salt.

2776.label: Leviticus 2:14
2776.text: “‘If you present the grain offering of the first ripe fruits to Jehovah, you should present new grain roasted with fire, coarsely crushed new kernels, as the grain offering of your first ripe fruits.

2777.label: Leviticus 2:15
2777.text: You are to put oil on it and place frankincense on it. It is a grain offering.

2778.label: Leviticus 2:16
2778.text: The priest will make it smoke as a token offering, that is, some of the coarse grain and oil along with all its frankincense, as an offering made by fire to Jehovah.

2779.label: Leviticus 3:1
2779.text: “‘If his offering is a communion sacrifice and if he is presenting it from the herd, whether a male or a female, he should present a sound animal before Jehovah.

2780.label: Leviticus 3:2
2780.text: He is to lay his hand on the head of his offering, and it will be slaughtered at the entrance of the tent of meeting; and Aaron’s sons, the priests, will sprinkle the blood on all sides of the altar.

2781.label: Leviticus 3:3
2781.text: He will present part of the communion sacrifice as an offering made by fire to Jehovah: the fat that covers the intestines, all the fat that surrounds the intestines,

2782.label: Leviticus 3:4
2782.text: and the two kidneys with the fat on them that is near the loins. He will also remove the appendage of the liver along with the kidneys.

2783.label: Leviticus 3:5
2783.text: Aaron’s sons will make it smoke on the altar on top of the burnt offering that is placed on the wood that is over the fire; it is an offering made by fire as a pleasing aroma to Jehovah.

2784.label: Leviticus 3:6
2784.text: “‘If his offering is from the flock for a communion sacrifice to Jehovah, he will present a sound male or a female animal.

2785.label: Leviticus 3:7
2785.text: If he is presenting a young ram as his offering, then he will present it before Jehovah.

2786.label: Leviticus 3:8
2786.text: He will lay his hand on the head of his offering, and it will be slaughtered in front of the tent of meeting. Aaron’s sons will sprinkle its blood on all sides of the altar.

2787.label: Leviticus 3:9
2787.text: He will present the fat from the communion sacrifice as an offering made by fire to Jehovah. He will remove the entire fat tail near the backbone, the fat that covers the intestines, all the fat that surrounds the intestines,

2788.label: Leviticus 3:10
2788.text: and the two kidneys with the fat on them that is near the loins. He will also remove the appendage of the liver along with the kidneys.

2789.label: Leviticus 3:11
2789.text: And the priest will make it smoke on the altar as food, an offering made by fire to Jehovah.

2790.label: Leviticus 3:12
2790.text: “‘If his offering is a goat, then he will present it before Jehovah.

2791.label: Leviticus 3:13
2791.text: He will lay his hand on its head, and it will be slaughtered before the tent of meeting, and Aaron’s sons must sprinkle its blood on all sides of the altar.

2792.label: Leviticus 3:14
2792.text: The part he will present as his offering made by fire to Jehovah is the fat that covers the intestines, all the fat that surrounds the intestines,

2793.label: Leviticus 3:15
2793.text: and the two kidneys with the fat on them that is near the loins. He will also remove the appendage of the liver along with the kidneys.

2794.label: Leviticus 3:16
2794.text: The priest will make them smoke on the altar as food, an offering made by fire for a pleasing aroma. All the fat belongs to Jehovah.

2795.label: Leviticus 3:17
2795.text: “‘It is a lasting statute for your generations, in all your dwelling places: You must not eat any fat or any blood at all.’”

2796.label: Leviticus 4:1
2796.text: Jehovah went on to say to Moses:

2797.label: Leviticus 4:2
2797.text: “Tell the Israelites, ‘If someone sins unintentionally by doing any of the things that Jehovah commanded should not be done:

2798.label: Leviticus 4:3
2798.text: “‘If the anointed priest sins and brings guilt on the people, then he must present a sound young bull to Jehovah as a sin offering for the sin he committed.

2799.label: Leviticus 4:4
2799.text: He will bring the bull to the entrance of the tent of meeting before Jehovah and lay his hand on the bull’s head, and he is to slaughter the bull before Jehovah.

2800.label: Leviticus 4:5
2800.text: Then the anointed priest will take some of the bull’s blood and bring it into the tent of meeting;

2801.label: Leviticus 4:6
2801.text: and the priest will dip his finger in the blood and spatter some of the blood seven times before Jehovah in front of the curtain of the holy place.

2802.label: Leviticus 4:7
2802.text: The priest will also put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of perfumed incense, which is before Jehovah in the tent of meeting; and he will pour all the rest of the bull’s blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

2803.label: Leviticus 4:8
2803.text: “‘He will then remove all the fat of the bull of the sin offering, including the fat that covers the intestines and the fat that surrounds the intestines,

2804.label: Leviticus 4:9
2804.text: and the two kidneys with the fat on them that is near the loins. And he will remove the appendage of the liver along with the kidneys.

2805.label: Leviticus 4:10
2805.text: It will be the same as what is removed from a bull of the communion sacrifice. And the priest will make them smoke on the altar of burnt offering.

2806.label: Leviticus 4:11
2806.text: “‘But as for the skin of the bull and all its flesh along with its head, its shanks, its intestines, and its dung —

2807.label: Leviticus 4:12
2807.text: all the rest of the bull—he will have it taken to the outskirts of the camp to a clean place where the ashes are discarded, and he will burn it on wood in the fire. It should be burned where the ashes are discarded.

2808.label: Leviticus 4:13
2808.text: “‘Now if the entire assembly of Israel has become guilty by committing a sin unintentionally, but the congregation was unaware that they had done something that Jehovah commanded them not to do,

2809.label: Leviticus 4:14
2809.text: and then the sin becomes known, the congregation must present a young bull for a sin offering and bring it before the tent of meeting.

2810.label: Leviticus 4:15
2810.text: The elders of the assembly will lay their hands on the bull’s head before Jehovah, and the bull will be slaughtered before Jehovah.

2811.label: Leviticus 4:16
2811.text: “‘Then the anointed priest will bring some of the bull’s blood into the tent of meeting.

2812.label: Leviticus 4:17
2812.text: The priest is to dip his finger into the blood and spatter some of it seven times before Jehovah in front of the curtain.

2813.label: Leviticus 4:18
2813.text: He will then put some of the blood on the horns of the altar that is before Jehovah, which is in the tent of meeting; and he will pour all the rest of the blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

2814.label: Leviticus 4:19
2814.text: He will remove all its fat and make it smoke on the altar.

2815.label: Leviticus 4:20
2815.text: He is to do to the bull just as he did to the other bull of the sin offering. That is how he will do it, and the priest will make atonement for them, and they will be forgiven.

2816.label: Leviticus 4:21
2816.text: He will have the bull taken to the outskirts of the camp and will burn it, just as he burned the first bull. It is a sin offering for the congregation.

2817.label: Leviticus 4:22
2817.text: “‘When a chieftain unintentionally sins by doing one of all the things that Jehovah his God commands should not be done and has become guilty,

2818.label: Leviticus 4:23
2818.text: or if he becomes aware of a sin that he has committed against the commandment, then he must bring a sound young male goat as his offering.

2819.label: Leviticus 4:24
2819.text: He will lay his hand on the head of the young goat and slaughter it in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered before Jehovah. It is a sin offering.

2820.label: Leviticus 4:25
2820.text: The priest will take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and he will pour the rest of its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.

2821.label: Leviticus 4:26
2821.text: He will make all its fat smoke on the altar like the fat of the communion sacrifice; and the priest will make atonement for him for his sin, and it will be forgiven him.

2822.label: Leviticus 4:27
2822.text: “‘If any one of the people of the land sins unintentionally and becomes guilty by doing one of the things that Jehovah commands should not be done,

2823.label: Leviticus 4:28
2823.text: or if he becomes aware of a sin that he has committed, then he should bring a sound young female goat as his offering for the sin he has committed.

2824.label: Leviticus 4:29
2824.text: He will lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter the sin offering in the same place as the burnt offering.

2825.label: Leviticus 4:30
2825.text: The priest will take some of its blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and he will pour all the rest of its blood at the base of the altar.

2826.label: Leviticus 4:31
2826.text: He will remove all its fat, just as the fat is removed from the communion sacrifice, and the priest will make it smoke on the altar as a pleasing aroma to Jehovah; and the priest will make atonement for him, and it will be forgiven him.

2827.label: Leviticus 4:32
2827.text: “‘But if he offers a lamb as his sin offering, he should bring a sound female lamb.

2828.label: Leviticus 4:33
2828.text: He will lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it as a sin offering in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered.

2829.label: Leviticus 4:34
2829.text: The priest will take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and he will pour all the rest of its blood at the base of the altar.

2830.label: Leviticus 4:35
2830.text: He will remove all its fat the same way that the fat of the young ram of the communion sacrifice is removed, and the priest will make them smoke on the altar on top of Jehovah’s offerings made by fire; and the priest will make atonement for him for the sin that he has committed, and it will be forgiven him.

2831.label: Leviticus 5:1
2831.text: “‘If someone sins because he has heard a public call to testify and he is a witness or has seen or learned about it and he does not report it, then he will answer for his error.

2832.label: Leviticus 5:2
2832.text: “‘Or when a person touches anything unclean, whether the dead body of an unclean wild animal, an unclean domestic animal, or an unclean swarming creature, he is unclean and has become guilty even if he does not realize it.

2833.label: Leviticus 5:3
2833.text: Or in case someone without being aware of it touches human uncleanness —anything unclean that may make him unclean—and he comes to know it, then he becomes guilty.

2834.label: Leviticus 5:4
2834.text: “‘Or if someone rashly swears to do something—whether it is to do good or to do evil, no matter what it may be—and he was unaware of it, but then he realizes that he has sworn rashly, he becomes guilty.

2835.label: Leviticus 5:5
2835.text: “‘If he becomes guilty as respects one of these things, then he must confess in what way he has sinned.

2836.label: Leviticus 5:6
2836.text: He will also bring his guilt offering to Jehovah for the sin that he committed, namely, a female from the flock, either a female lamb or a young female goat, for a sin offering. Then the priest will make atonement for him for his sin.

2837.label: Leviticus 5:7
2837.text: “‘If, though, he cannot afford a sheep, he must bring to Jehovah two turtledoves or two young pigeons as his guilt offering for the sin, one for a sin offering and one for a burnt offering.

2838.label: Leviticus 5:8
2838.text: He is to bring them to the priest, who will present first the one for the sin offering and nip off its head at the front of its neck, without severing it.

2839.label: Leviticus 5:9
2839.text: He will spatter some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar, but the remainder of the blood will be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

2840.label: Leviticus 5:10
2840.text: He will handle the other one as a burnt offering according to the regular procedure; and the priest will make atonement for him for the sin that he has committed, and it will be forgiven him.

2841.label: Leviticus 5:11
2841.text: “‘Now if he cannot afford two turtledoves or two young pigeons, he must bring as his offering for his sin a tenth of an eʹphah of fine flour for a sin offering. He should not add oil to it or place frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering.

2842.label: Leviticus 5:12
2842.text: He will bring it to the priest, and the priest will take from it his handful as a token offering and make it smoke on the altar on top of Jehovah’s offerings made by fire. It is a sin offering.

2843.label: Leviticus 5:13
2843.text: The priest will make atonement for him for the sin that he has committed, any one of these sins, and it will be forgiven him. The remainder of the offering will become the priest’s, just like the grain offering.’”

2844.label: Leviticus 5:14
2844.text: Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

2845.label: Leviticus 5:15
2845.text: “If someone behaves unfaithfully by unintentionally sinning against the holy things of Jehovah, he is to bring to Jehovah a sound ram from the flock as a guilt offering; its value in silver shekels is set according to the standard shekel of the holy place.

2846.label: Leviticus 5:16
2846.text: And he will make compensation for the sin he has committed against the holy place and he will also add a fifth of its value. He will give it to the priest, so that the priest may make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt offering, and it will be forgiven him.

2847.label: Leviticus 5:17
2847.text: “If someone sins by doing any of the things that Jehovah commands should not be done, even if he is not aware of it, he is still guilty and will answer for his error.

2848.label: Leviticus 5:18
2848.text: He should bring to the priest a sound ram from the flock according to the estimated value, for a guilt offering. Then the priest will make atonement for him for the unintentional mistake that he unknowingly committed, and it will be forgiven him.

2849.label: Leviticus 5:19
2849.text: It is a guilt offering. He has certainly become guilty of sinning against Jehovah.”

2850.label: Leviticus 6:1
2850.text: Jehovah went on to say to Moses:

2851.label: Leviticus 6:2
2851.text: “If someone sins and behaves unfaithfully toward Jehovah by deceiving his neighbor in connection with something entrusted to him, or something deposited with him, or he robs or defrauds his neighbor,

2852.label: Leviticus 6:3
2852.text: or he finds something lost and is deceptive about it, and if he swears falsely over any such sin he may commit, this is what he should do:

2853.label: Leviticus 6:4
2853.text: If he has sinned and is guilty, he must return what he stole, what he extorted, what he took by fraud, what was entrusted to him, or the lost thing that he found,

2854.label: Leviticus 6:5
2854.text: or anything about which he swore falsely, and he must make full compensation for it, and he will add to it a fifth of its value. He will give it to the owner on the day his guilt is proved.

2855.label: Leviticus 6:6
2855.text: And he will bring to the priest as his guilt offering to Jehovah a sound ram from the flock according to the assessed value, for a guilt offering.

2856.label: Leviticus 6:7
2856.text: The priest will make atonement for him before Jehovah, and he will be forgiven for anything he may have done resulting in his guilt.”

2857.label: Leviticus 6:8
2857.text: Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

2858.label: Leviticus 6:9
2858.text: “Command Aaron and his sons and say, ‘This is the law of the burnt offering: The burnt offering will remain on the hearth on the altar all night long until the morning, and the fire will be kept burning on the altar.

2859.label: Leviticus 6:10
2859.text: The priest will clothe himself with his official dress of linen, and he will put the linen shorts on over his flesh. Then he will remove the ashes of the burnt offering that the fire had consumed on the altar and place them beside the altar.

2860.label: Leviticus 6:11
2860.text: Then he will take off his garments and put on other garments and take the ashes to a clean place outside the camp.

2861.label: Leviticus 6:12
2861.text: The fire will be kept burning on the altar. It must not go out. The priest must burn wood on it each morning and arrange the burnt offering over it, and he will make the fat of the communion sacrifices smoke over it.

2862.label: Leviticus 6:13
2862.text: Fire will be kept constantly burning on the altar. It must not go out.

2863.label: Leviticus 6:14
2863.text: “‘Now this is the law of the grain offering: You sons of Aaron are to present it before Jehovah in front of the altar.

2864.label: Leviticus 6:15
2864.text: One of them will take a handful from the fine flour of the grain offering and some of its oil and all the frankincense that is on the grain offering, and he will make it smoke on the altar as a pleasing aroma for a token offering to Jehovah.

2865.label: Leviticus 6:16
2865.text: Aaron and his sons will eat what is left of it. It will be eaten as unleavened bread in a holy place. They will eat it in the courtyard of the tent of meeting.

2866.label: Leviticus 6:17
2866.text: It should not be baked with anything leavened. I have given it as their share out of my offerings made by fire. It is something most holy, like the sin offering and like the guilt offering.

2867.label: Leviticus 6:18
2867.text: Every male among the sons of Aaron will eat it. It is their permanent allowance throughout your generations from Jehovah’s offerings made by fire. Everything that touches them will become holy.’”

2869.label: Leviticus 6:20
2869.text: “This is the offering that Aaron and his sons will present to Jehovah on the day he is anointed: the tenth of an eʹphah of fine flour as a regular grain offering, half of it in the morning and half of it in the evening.

2870.label: Leviticus 6:21
2870.text: It will be made with oil on a griddle. You will bring it well-mixed with oil and present it in pieces as a baked product of the grain offering as a pleasing aroma to Jehovah.

2871.label: Leviticus 6:22
2871.text: The anointed priest who succeeds him from among his sons will make it. It is a lasting regulation: As a whole offering it will be made to smoke to Jehovah.

2872.label: Leviticus 6:23
2872.text: Every grain offering of a priest should be a whole offering. It must not be eaten.”

2873.label: Leviticus 6:24
2873.text: Jehovah spoke again to Moses and said:

2874.label: Leviticus 6:25
2874.text: “Tell Aaron and his sons, ‘This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered, the sin offering will also be slaughtered before Jehovah. It is a most holy thing.

2875.label: Leviticus 6:26
2875.text: The priest who offers it for sin will eat it. It will be eaten in a holy place, in the courtyard of the tent of meeting.

2876.label: Leviticus 6:27
2876.text: “‘Everything that touches its flesh will become holy, and when anyone spatters some of its blood on his garment, you should wash what was spattered with blood in a holy place.

2877.label: Leviticus 6:28
2877.text: The earthenware vessel in which it was boiled is to be shattered. But if it was boiled in a copper vessel, then the vessel must be scoured and washed with water.

2878.label: Leviticus 6:29
2878.text: “‘Every male among the priests will eat it. It is something most holy.

2879.label: Leviticus 6:30
2879.text: However, no sin offering is to be eaten if some of its blood is brought into the tent of meeting to make atonement in the holy place. It is to be burned with fire.

2880.label: Leviticus 7:1
2880.text: “‘This is the law of the guilt offering: It is something most holy.

2881.label: Leviticus 7:2
2881.text: They will slaughter the guilt offering in the place where they slaughter the burnt offerings, and its blood should be sprinkled on all sides of the altar.

2882.label: Leviticus 7:3
2882.text: He will present all its fat, including the fat tail, the fat that covers the intestines,

2883.label: Leviticus 7:4
2883.text: and the two kidneys with their fat that is near the loins. He will also remove the appendage of the liver along with the kidneys.

2884.label: Leviticus 7:5
2884.text: The priest will make them smoke on the altar as an offering made by fire to Jehovah. It is a guilt offering.

2885.label: Leviticus 7:6
2885.text: Every male among the priests will eat it, and it should be eaten in a holy place. It is something most holy.

2886.label: Leviticus 7:7
2886.text: The law regarding the sin offering applies to the guilt offering; it belongs to the priest who makes atonement with it.

2887.label: Leviticus 7:8
2887.text: “‘When the priest presents the burnt offering for someone, the skin of the burnt offering that was presented to the priest will become his.

2888.label: Leviticus 7:9
2888.text: “‘Every grain offering that is baked in the oven or prepared in the pan or on the griddle belongs to the priest who presents it. It will become his.

2889.label: Leviticus 7:10
2889.text: But every grain offering that is mixed with oil or that is dry will be for all of Aaron’s sons; each will have an equal share.

2890.label: Leviticus 7:11
2890.text: “‘Now this is the law of the communion sacrifice that one may present to Jehovah:

2891.label: Leviticus 7:12
2891.text: If he presents it as an expression of thanksgiving, he will present along with the thanksgiving sacrifice unleavened ring-shaped loaves mixed with oil, unleavened wafers spread with oil, and ring-shaped loaves made with fine flour, well-mixed and blended with oil.

2892.label: Leviticus 7:13
2892.text: He will present his offering along with ring-shaped loaves of leavened bread and the thanksgiving sacrifice of his communion sacrifices.

2893.label: Leviticus 7:14
2893.text: He is to present from it one of each offering as a sacred portion to Jehovah; it will belong to the priest who sprinkles the blood of the communion sacrifices.

2894.label: Leviticus 7:15
2894.text: The flesh of the thanksgiving sacrifice of his communion sacrifices is to be eaten on the day he offers it. He must not save any of it until morning.

2895.label: Leviticus 7:16
2895.text: “‘If the sacrifice of his offering is a vow or a voluntary offering, it is to be eaten on the day he presents his sacrifice, and what is left of it may also be eaten on the next day.

2896.label: Leviticus 7:17
2896.text: But whatever is left of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day is to be burned with fire.

2897.label: Leviticus 7:18
2897.text: However, if any of the flesh of his communion sacrifice is eaten on the third day, the one presenting it will not be accepted with approval. It will not be credited to him; it is an offensive thing, and the person who eats some of it will answer for his error.

2898.label: Leviticus 7:19
2898.text: Flesh that touches anything unclean is not to be eaten. It is to be burned with fire. Everyone who is clean may eat the clean flesh.

2899.label: Leviticus 7:20
2899.text: “‘But any person who is unclean and eats the flesh of the communion sacrifice, which is for Jehovah, that person must be cut off from his people.

2900.label: Leviticus 7:21
2900.text: If someone touches anything unclean, whether the uncleanness of a man or an unclean animal or any unclean disgusting thing, and eats some of the flesh of the communion sacrifice, which is for Jehovah, that person must be cut off from his people.’”

2901.label: Leviticus 7:22
2901.text: Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

2902.label: Leviticus 7:23
2902.text: “Tell the Israelites, ‘You must not eat any fat of a bull or a young ram or a goat.

2903.label: Leviticus 7:24
2903.text: The fat of an animal found dead and the fat of an animal killed by another animal may be used for any other purpose, but you must never eat it.

2904.label: Leviticus 7:25
2904.text: For whoever eats fat from an animal that he presents as an offering made by fire to Jehovah must be cut off from his people.

2905.label: Leviticus 7:26
2905.text: “‘You must not eat any blood in any of your dwelling places, whether that of birds or that of animals.

2906.label: Leviticus 7:27
2906.text: Anyone who eats any blood must be cut off from his people.’”

2907.label: Leviticus 7:28
2907.text: Jehovah went on to speak to Moses, saying:

2908.label: Leviticus 7:29
2908.text: “Tell the Israelites, ‘Whoever presents his communion sacrifice to Jehovah will bring part of the offering from his communion sacrifice to Jehovah.

2909.label: Leviticus 7:30
2909.text: He will bring in his own hands the fat along with the breast as an offering made by fire to Jehovah, and he will wave it back and forth as a wave offering before Jehovah.

2910.label: Leviticus 7:31
2910.text: The priest will make the fat smoke on the altar, but the breast will belong to Aaron and his sons.

2911.label: Leviticus 7:32
2911.text: “‘You will give the right leg as a sacred portion to the priest from your communion sacrifices.

2912.label: Leviticus 7:33
2912.text: The son of Aaron who presents the blood of the communion sacrifices and the fat will have the right leg as his portion.

2913.label: Leviticus 7:34
2913.text: For I take the breast of the wave offering and the leg of the sacred portion from the communion sacrifices of the Israelites, and I give them to Aaron the priest and his sons as a lasting regulation for the Israelites.

2914.label: Leviticus 7:35
2914.text: “‘This was the portion from Jehovah’s offerings made by fire to be set aside for the priests, for Aaron and his sons, on the day he presented them to serve as priests to Jehovah.

2915.label: Leviticus 7:36
2915.text: Jehovah commanded to give them this portion from the Israelites on the day he anointed them. It is a permanent statute for their generations.’”

2916.label: Leviticus 7:37
2916.text: This is the law concerning the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering, the guilt offering, the installation sacrifice, and the communion sacrifice,

2917.label: Leviticus 7:38
2917.text: just as Jehovah commanded Moses on Mount Siʹnai in the day he commanded the Israelites to present their offerings to Jehovah in the wilderness of Siʹnai.

2918.label: Leviticus 8:1
2918.text: Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

2919.label: Leviticus 8:2
2919.text: “Take Aaron and his sons with him, the garments, the anointing oil, the bull of the sin offering, the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread,

2920.label: Leviticus 8:3
2920.text: and make all the assembly gather together at the entrance of the tent of meeting.”

2921.label: Leviticus 8:4
2921.text: Then Moses did just as Jehovah had commanded him, and the assembly gathered together at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

2922.label: Leviticus 8:5
2922.text: Moses now said to the assembly: “This is what Jehovah has commanded us to do.”

2923.label: Leviticus 8:6
2923.text: So Moses brought Aaron and his sons near and washed them with water.

2924.label: Leviticus 8:7
2924.text: After that he put the robe on him, wrapped him with the sash, clothed him with the sleeveless coat, and put the ephʹod on him and tied it with the woven belt of the ephʹod, binding it securely on him.

2925.label: Leviticus 8:8
2925.text: Next he placed the breastpiece on him and put the Uʹrim and the Thumʹmim in the breastpiece.

2926.label: Leviticus 8:9
2926.text: Then he placed the turban on his head, and he put on the front of the turban the shining plate of gold, the holy sign of dedication, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2927.label: Leviticus 8:10
2927.text: Moses then took the anointing oil and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it and sanctified them.

2928.label: Leviticus 8:11
2928.text: After that he spattered some of it seven times on the altar and anointed the altar and all its utensils and the basin and its stand in order to sanctify them.

2929.label: Leviticus 8:12
2929.text: Finally he poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head and anointed him in order to sanctify him.

2930.label: Leviticus 8:13
2930.text: Moses then brought Aaron’s sons near and clothed them with robes and wrapped them with sashes and put headgear on them, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2931.label: Leviticus 8:14
2931.text: Then he brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.

2932.label: Leviticus 8:15
2932.text: Moses slaughtered it and took the blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar on all sides, and he purified the altar from sin, but the rest of the blood he poured at the base of the altar, in order to sanctify it to make atonement on it.

2933.label: Leviticus 8:16
2933.text: After that he took all the fat that was on the intestines, the appendage of the liver, and the two kidneys and their fat, and Moses made them smoke on the altar.

2934.label: Leviticus 8:17
2934.text: Then he had the rest of the bull, its skin, its flesh, and its dung, burned with fire outside the camp, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2935.label: Leviticus 8:18
2935.text: He now brought the ram of the burnt offering near, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

2936.label: Leviticus 8:19
2936.text: Moses then slaughtered it and sprinkled the blood on all sides of the altar.

2937.label: Leviticus 8:20
2937.text: He cut the ram into its pieces, and Moses made the head, the pieces, and the suet smoke.

2938.label: Leviticus 8:21
2938.text: He washed the intestines and the shanks with water, and Moses made the entire ram smoke on the altar. It was a burnt offering as a pleasing aroma. It was an offering made by fire to Jehovah, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2939.label: Leviticus 8:22
2939.text: Then he brought the second ram, the ram of the installation, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the ram’s head.

2940.label: Leviticus 8:23
2940.text: Moses slaughtered it and took some of its blood and put it on Aaron’s right earlobe and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

2941.label: Leviticus 8:24
2941.text: Next Moses brought Aaron’s sons forward and put some of the blood on their right earlobe and on the thumb of their right hand and on the big toe of their right foot; but Moses sprinkled the rest of the blood on all sides of the altar.

2942.label: Leviticus 8:25
2942.text: Then he took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat that was on the intestines, the appendage of the liver, the two kidneys and their fat, and the right leg.

2943.label: Leviticus 8:26
2943.text: He took out of the basket of unleavened bread that was before Jehovah one unleavened ring-shaped loaf, one ring-shaped loaf of oiled bread, and one wafer. He then placed them on the pieces of fat and the right leg.

2944.label: Leviticus 8:27
2944.text: After that he put all of them on the palms of Aaron and the palms of his sons and began to wave them back and forth as a wave offering before Jehovah.

2945.label: Leviticus 8:28
2945.text: Then Moses took them from their hands and made them smoke on the altar on top of the burnt offering. They were an installation sacrifice as a pleasing aroma. It was an offering made by fire to Jehovah.

2946.label: Leviticus 8:29
2946.text: Moses then took the breast and waved it back and forth as a wave offering before Jehovah. From the installation ram it became the portion for Moses, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2947.label: Leviticus 8:30
2947.text: And Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood that was on the altar and spattered it on Aaron and his garments and on his sons and the garments of his sons who were with him. Thus he sanctified Aaron and his garments and his sons and their garments.

2948.label: Leviticus 8:31
2948.text: Then Moses said to Aaron and his sons: “Boil the flesh at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and you will eat it there with the bread that is in the installation basket, just as I was commanded, ‘Aaron and his sons will eat it.’

2949.label: Leviticus 8:32
2949.text: What is left over of the flesh and the bread you will burn with fire.

2950.label: Leviticus 8:33
2950.text: You must not go out from the entrance of the tent of meeting for seven days, until the days for completing your installation are over, because it will take seven days to install you as priests.

2951.label: Leviticus 8:34
2951.text: Jehovah commanded that we do what we have done today in order to make atonement for you.

2952.label: Leviticus 8:35
2952.text: You will stay at the entrance of the tent of meeting day and night for seven days and carry out your obligation to Jehovah, so that you may not die; for so I have been commanded.”

2953.label: Leviticus 8:36
2953.text: And Aaron and his sons did all the things that Jehovah had commanded by means of Moses.

2954.label: Leviticus 9:1
2954.text: On the eighth day, Moses called Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.

2955.label: Leviticus 9:2
2955.text: He said to Aaron: “Take for yourself a young calf for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering, sound ones, and present them before Jehovah.

2956.label: Leviticus 9:3
2956.text: But you will say to the Israelites, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering and a calf and a young ram, each a year old, sound ones, for a burnt offering,

2957.label: Leviticus 9:4
2957.text: and a bull and a ram for communion sacrifices, to sacrifice them before Jehovah, and a grain offering mixed with oil, for today Jehovah will appear to you.’”

2958.label: Leviticus 9:5
2958.text: So they took what Moses had commanded before the tent of meeting. Then the whole assembly came forward and stood before Jehovah.

2959.label: Leviticus 9:6
2959.text: And Moses said: “This is what Jehovah has commanded you to do, so that the glory of Jehovah may appear to you.”

2960.label: Leviticus 9:7
2960.text: Then Moses said to Aaron: “Approach the altar and present your sin offering and your burnt offering, and make atonement in your own behalf and in behalf of your house; and present the offering of the people, and make atonement in their behalf, just as Jehovah has commanded.”

2961.label: Leviticus 9:8
2961.text: Aaron immediately approached the altar and slaughtered the calf of the sin offering that was for him.

2962.label: Leviticus 9:9
2962.text: Then Aaron’s sons presented the blood to him, and he dipped his finger in the blood and put it on the horns of the altar, and he poured the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

2963.label: Leviticus 9:10
2963.text: He made the fat and the kidneys and the appendage of the liver from the sin offering smoke on the altar, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2964.label: Leviticus 9:11
2964.text: And he burned the flesh and the skin with fire outside the camp.

2965.label: Leviticus 9:12
2965.text: Then he slaughtered the burnt offering, and Aaron’s sons handed him the blood, and he sprinkled it on all sides of the altar.

2966.label: Leviticus 9:13
2966.text: They handed him the pieces of the burnt offering along with the head, and he made them smoke on the altar.

2967.label: Leviticus 9:14
2967.text: Further, he washed the intestines and the shanks and made them smoke on the burnt offering on the altar.

2968.label: Leviticus 9:15
2968.text: He then presented the offering of the people and took the goat of the sin offering that was for the people and slaughtered it and made a sin offering with it like the first one.

2969.label: Leviticus 9:16
2969.text: And he presented the burnt offering and handled it according to the regular procedure.

2970.label: Leviticus 9:17
2970.text: He next presented the grain offering, filling his hand with some of it and making it smoke on the altar, in addition to the burnt offering of the morning.

2971.label: Leviticus 9:18
2971.text: After that he slaughtered the bull and the ram of the communion sacrifice that was for the people. Then Aaron’s sons handed him the blood, and he sprinkled it around on all sides of the altar.

2972.label: Leviticus 9:19
2972.text: As for the pieces of fat of the bull, the fat tail of the ram, the fat covering the internal organs, the kidneys, and the appendage of the liver,

2973.label: Leviticus 9:20
2973.text: they placed all those pieces of fat on the breasts, after which he made the pieces of fat smoke on the altar.

2974.label: Leviticus 9:21
2974.text: But the breasts and the right leg Aaron waved back and forth as a wave offering before Jehovah, just as Moses had commanded.

2975.label: Leviticus 9:22
2975.text: Then Aaron raised his hands toward the people and blessed them and came down from making the sin offering and the burnt offering and the communion sacrifices.

2976.label: Leviticus 9:23
2976.text: Finally Moses and Aaron went into the tent of meeting and came out and blessed the people. Jehovah’s glory now appeared to all the people,

2977.label: Leviticus 9:24
2977.text: and fire came out from Jehovah and began consuming the burnt offering and the pieces of fat on the altar. When all the people saw it, they started shouting and they fell with their faces to the ground.

2978.label: Leviticus 10:1
2978.text: Later Aaron’s sons Naʹdab and A·biʹhu each took his fire holder and put fire in it and placed incense on it. Then they began offering before Jehovah unauthorized fire, which he had not commanded them to do.

2979.label: Leviticus 10:2
2979.text: At this a fire came out from before Jehovah and consumed them, so that they died before Jehovah.

2980.label: Leviticus 10:3
2980.text: Then Moses said to Aaron: “This is what Jehovah has said, ‘I will be made holy among those near to me, and I will be glorified before all the people.’” And Aaron kept silent.

2981.label: Leviticus 10:4
2981.text: So Moses called Mishʹa·el and El·zaʹphan, the sons of Uzʹzi·el, Aaron’s uncle, and said to them: “Come here, carry your brothers from in front of the holy place to a place outside the camp.”

2982.label: Leviticus 10:5
2982.text: So they came forward and carried the men away in their robes to a place outside the camp, just as Moses had told them.

2983.label: Leviticus 10:6
2983.text: Moses then said to Aaron and his other sons El·e·aʹzar and Ithʹa·mar: “Do not let your heads go ungroomed or tear your garments, so that you may not die and that God may not become indignant against all the assembly. Your brothers of the whole house of Israel will weep over those whom Jehovah has killed by the fire.

2984.label: Leviticus 10:7
2984.text: You must not go out from the entrance of the tent of meeting or you will die, for Jehovah’s anointing oil is upon you.” So they did according to Moses’ word.

2986.label: Leviticus 10:9
2986.text: “Do not drink wine or other alcoholic beverages, you and your sons with you, when you come into the tent of meeting, so that you will not die. It is a permanent statute for your generations.

2987.label: Leviticus 10:10
2987.text: This is to distinguish between the holy thing and the profane and between the unclean thing and the clean,

2988.label: Leviticus 10:11
2988.text: and to teach the Israelites all the regulations that Jehovah has spoken to them through Moses.”

2989.label: Leviticus 10:12
2989.text: Then Moses spoke to Aaron and to El·e·aʹzar and Ithʹa·mar, his sons who were left: “Take what was left of the grain offering from Jehovah’s offerings made by fire and eat it as unleavened bread near the altar, because it is something most holy.

2990.label: Leviticus 10:13
2990.text: You must eat it in a holy place, because it is your allowance and the allowance of your sons from Jehovah’s offerings made by fire, for this is what I have been commanded.

2991.label: Leviticus 10:14
2991.text: You will also eat the breast of the wave offering and the leg of the sacred portion in a clean place, you and your sons and your daughters with you, because these things have been given as your allowance and the allowance of your sons from the communion sacrifices of the Israelites.

2992.label: Leviticus 10:15
2992.text: They will bring the leg of the sacred portion and the breast of the wave offering along with the offerings of fat made by fire, in order to wave the wave offering back and forth before Jehovah; and it will serve as a permanent allowance for you and your sons with you, just as Jehovah has commanded.”

2993.label: Leviticus 10:16
2993.text: And Moses diligently searched for the goat of the sin offering, and he discovered that it had been burned up. So he grew indignant at El·e·aʹzar and Ithʹa·mar, Aaron’s sons who were left, and he said:

2994.label: Leviticus 10:17
2994.text: “Why did you not eat the sin offering in the holy place, since it is something most holy and he has given it to you so that you may answer for the error of the assembly and make atonement for them before Jehovah?

2995.label: Leviticus 10:18
2995.text: Look! Its blood has not been brought inside the holy place. You certainly should have eaten it in the holy place, just as I was commanded.”

2996.label: Leviticus 10:19
2996.text: Aaron replied to Moses: “Look! Today they presented their sin offering and their burnt offering before Jehovah, and yet these things happened to me. If I had eaten the sin offering today, would that have been pleasing to Jehovah?”

2997.label: Leviticus 10:20
2997.text: When Moses heard that, he was satisfied.

2998.label: Leviticus 11:1
2998.text: Then Jehovah said to Moses and Aaron:

2999.label: Leviticus 11:2
2999.text: “Tell the Israelites, ‘These are the living creatures of the earth that you may eat:

3000.label: Leviticus 11:3
3000.text: Every animal that has a split hoof and a cleft in its hooves and that chews the cud may be eaten.

3001.label: Leviticus 11:4
3001.text: “‘But you must not eat these animals that chew the cud or have a split hoof: the camel, which chews the cud but does not have a split hoof. It is unclean for you.

3002.label: Leviticus 11:5
3002.text: Also the rock badger, because it chews the cud but does not have a split hoof. It is unclean for you.

3003.label: Leviticus 11:6
3003.text: Also the hare, because it chews the cud but does not have a split hoof. It is unclean for you.

3004.label: Leviticus 11:7
3004.text: Also the pig, because it has a split hoof and a cleft in the hoof but does not chew the cud. It is unclean for you.

3005.label: Leviticus 11:8
3005.text: You must not eat any of their flesh or touch their dead body. They are unclean for you.

3006.label: Leviticus 11:9
3006.text: “‘This is what you may eat of everything in the waters: Anything in the waters that has fins and scales, whether in the seas or in the rivers, it you may eat.

3007.label: Leviticus 11:10
3007.text: But anything in the seas and in the rivers that has no fins and scales, among all the swarming creatures and of every other living creature that is in the waters, it is a loathsome thing for you.

3008.label: Leviticus 11:11
3008.text: Yes, they should be loathsome to you, and you must not eat any of their flesh and you must loathe their carcasses.

3009.label: Leviticus 11:12
3009.text: Everything in the waters that has no fins and scales is a loathsome thing to you.

3010.label: Leviticus 11:13
3010.text: “‘These are the flying creatures that you are to loathe; they should not be eaten, for they are loathsome: the eagle, the osprey, the black vulture,

3011.label: Leviticus 11:14
3011.text: the red kite and every kind of black kite,

3013.label: Leviticus 11:16
3013.text: the ostrich, the owl, the gull, every kind of falcon,

3014.label: Leviticus 11:17
3014.text: the little owl, the cormorant, the long-eared owl,

3015.label: Leviticus 11:18
3015.text: the swan, the pelican, the vulture,

3016.label: Leviticus 11:19
3016.text: the stork, every kind of heron, the hoopoe, and the bat.

3017.label: Leviticus 11:20
3017.text: Every winged swarming creature that goes on all fours is something loathsome to you.

3018.label: Leviticus 11:21
3018.text: “‘Of the winged swarming creatures that move on all fours, you may eat only those that have jointed legs above their feet for leaping on the ground.

3019.label: Leviticus 11:22
3019.text: Of these you may eat: various kinds of migratory locusts, other edible locusts, crickets, and grasshoppers.

3020.label: Leviticus 11:23
3020.text: All other winged swarming creatures with four legs are something loathsome to you.

3021.label: Leviticus 11:24
3021.text: By these you would make yourselves unclean. Everyone touching their dead bodies will be unclean until the evening.

3022.label: Leviticus 11:25
3022.text: Anyone carrying any of their dead bodies should wash his garments; he will be unclean until the evening.

3023.label: Leviticus 11:26
3023.text: “‘Any animal that has a split hoof but does not have a cleft and does not chew its cud is unclean to you. Everyone touching them will be unclean.

3024.label: Leviticus 11:27
3024.text: Every living creature that walks on paws among the creatures that walk on all fours is unclean to you. Everyone touching their dead bodies will be unclean until the evening.

3025.label: Leviticus 11:28
3025.text: The one who carries their dead bodies should wash his garments, and he will be unclean until the evening. They are unclean to you.

3026.label: Leviticus 11:29
3026.text: “‘These are the swarming creatures of the earth that are unclean to you: the mole rat, the mouse, every kind of lizard,

3027.label: Leviticus 11:30
3027.text: the gecko, the large lizard, the newt, the sand lizard, and the chameleon.

3028.label: Leviticus 11:31
3028.text: These swarming creatures are unclean to you. Everyone touching their dead bodies will be unclean until the evening.

3029.label: Leviticus 11:32
3029.text: “‘Now anything they fall on when they die will be unclean, whether a wooden utensil, a garment, a skin, or a piece of sackcloth. Any utensil that is used should be immersed in water, and it will be unclean until the evening; then it will be clean.

3030.label: Leviticus 11:33
3030.text: If they fall into an earthenware vessel, you are to smash it, and anything that was in it will be unclean.

3031.label: Leviticus 11:34
3031.text: Any kind of food that comes in contact with water from such a vessel will be unclean, and any drinkable liquid in such a vessel will be unclean.

3032.label: Leviticus 11:35
3032.text: Anything their dead bodies fall on will be unclean. Whether oven or small stove, it should be broken into pieces. They are unclean, and they will remain unclean to you.

3033.label: Leviticus 11:36
3033.text: Only a spring and a cistern for storing water will continue clean, but anyone touching their dead bodies will be unclean.

3034.label: Leviticus 11:37
3034.text: If their dead bodies fall on a plant seed that is to be sown, it is clean.

3035.label: Leviticus 11:38
3035.text: But if water is put on a seed and part of their dead body falls on it, the seed is unclean to you.

3036.label: Leviticus 11:39
3036.text: “‘Now if an animal that you use for food dies, whoever touches its dead body will be unclean until the evening.

3037.label: Leviticus 11:40
3037.text: Whoever eats any of its dead body should wash his garments, and he will be unclean until the evening. Whoever carries off its dead body should wash his garments, and he will be unclean until the evening.

3038.label: Leviticus 11:41
3038.text: Every swarming creature of the earth is something loathsome. It must not be eaten.

3039.label: Leviticus 11:42
3039.text: You must not eat any creature that crawls on its belly, any creature that goes on all fours, or any of earth’s swarming creatures with a great number of legs, for they are something loathsome.

3040.label: Leviticus 11:43
3040.text: Do not make yourselves loathsome by means of any swarming creature, and do not defile yourselves and become unclean by them.

3041.label: Leviticus 11:44
3041.text: For I am Jehovah your God, and you must sanctify yourselves and become holy, because I am holy. So you must not make yourselves unclean by any swarming creature that moves on the earth.

3042.label: Leviticus 11:45
3042.text: For I am Jehovah, who is leading you up out of the land of Egypt to prove myself God to you, and you must be holy, because I am holy.

3043.label: Leviticus 11:46
3043.text: “‘This is the law about the animals, the flying creatures, every living creature that moves through the waters, and concerning every creature that swarms on the earth,

3044.label: Leviticus 11:47
3044.text: in order to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean and between the living creatures that may be eaten and those that may not be eaten.’”

3045.label: Leviticus 12:1
3045.text: Jehovah went on to say to Moses:

3046.label: Leviticus 12:2
3046.text: “Tell the Israelites, ‘If a woman becomes pregnant and gives birth to a male, she will be unclean for seven days, just as she is in the days of the impurity when she is menstruating.

3047.label: Leviticus 12:3
3047.text: On the eighth day, the flesh of his foreskin will be circumcised.

3048.label: Leviticus 12:4
3048.text: She will continue cleansing herself from the blood for the next 33 days. She should not touch any holy thing, and she should not come into the holy place until she fulfills the days of her purification.

3049.label: Leviticus 12:5
3049.text: “‘If she should give birth to a female, she will then be unclean for 14 days, just as she would be during her menstruation. She will continue cleansing herself from the blood for the next 66 days.

3050.label: Leviticus 12:6
3050.text: When the days of her purification for a son or a daughter are completed, she will bring a young ram in its first year for a burnt offering and a young pigeon or a turtledove for a sin offering to the entrance of the tent of meeting, to the priest.

3051.label: Leviticus 12:7
3051.text: He will present it before Jehovah and make atonement for her, and she will be clean from her flow of blood. This is the law about the woman who gives birth to either a male or a female.

3052.label: Leviticus 12:8
3052.text: But if she cannot afford a sheep, she must then take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, one for a burnt offering and one for a sin offering, and the priest will make atonement for her, and she will be clean.’”

3053.label: Leviticus 13:1
3053.text: Jehovah continued to speak to Moses and Aaron, saying:

3054.label: Leviticus 13:2
3054.text: “If a man develops on his skin a swelling, a scab, or a blotch and it could become the disease of leprosy on his skin, he must then be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons, the priests.

3055.label: Leviticus 13:3
3055.text: The priest will examine the infection on his skin. When the hair in the infection has turned white and the appearance of the infection is deeper than the skin, it is the disease of leprosy. The priest will examine it and declare him unclean.

3056.label: Leviticus 13:4
3056.text: But if the blotch on his skin is white and its appearance is not deeper than the skin and the hair has not turned white, the priest will then quarantine the infected person for seven days.

3057.label: Leviticus 13:5
3057.text: The priest will then examine him on the seventh day, and if it appears that the infection has stopped and has not spread on the skin, the priest will quarantine him for another seven days.

3058.label: Leviticus 13:6
3058.text: “The priest should examine him again on the seventh day, and if the infection has faded and has not spread in the skin, the priest will declare him clean; it was only a scab. The man will then wash his garments and be clean.

3059.label: Leviticus 13:7
3059.text: But if the scab has definitely spread on the skin after he appears before the priest to establish his purification, he will then appear again before the priest.

3060.label: Leviticus 13:8
3060.text: The priest will examine it, and if the scab has spread in the skin, the priest will then declare him unclean. It is leprosy.

3061.label: Leviticus 13:9
3061.text: “If the disease of leprosy develops in a man, he must then be brought to the priest,

3062.label: Leviticus 13:10
3062.text: and the priest will examine him. If there is a white swelling on the skin and it has turned the hair white and there is an open sore in the swelling,

3063.label: Leviticus 13:11
3063.text: it is chronic leprosy on his skin, and the priest will declare him unclean. He should not quarantine him, for he is unclean.

3064.label: Leviticus 13:12
3064.text: Now if the leprosy breaks out all over the skin and the leprosy covers the person with the disease from head to foot, as far as the priest can see,

3065.label: Leviticus 13:13
3065.text: and the priest has examined him and sees that the leprosy has covered all his skin, he will then declare the infected person clean. All of it has turned white, and he is clean.

3066.label: Leviticus 13:14
3066.text: But whenever an open sore appears in it, he will be unclean.

3067.label: Leviticus 13:15
3067.text: When the priest sees the open sore, he will declare him unclean. The open sore is unclean. It is leprosy.

3068.label: Leviticus 13:16
3068.text: But if the open sore again turns white, he will then come to the priest.

3069.label: Leviticus 13:17
3069.text: The priest will examine him, and if the infection has turned white, the priest will then declare the infected person clean. He is clean.

3070.label: Leviticus 13:18
3070.text: “If a person develops a boil on his skin and it heals,

3071.label: Leviticus 13:19
3071.text: but in the place of the boil a white swelling or a reddish-white blotch has developed, he must then show himself to the priest.

3072.label: Leviticus 13:20
3072.text: The priest will examine it, and if it appears to be deeper than the skin and its hair has turned white, the priest will then declare him unclean. It is the disease of leprosy that has broken out in the boil.

3073.label: Leviticus 13:21
3073.text: But if the priest examines it and sees that there is no white hair in it and it is not deeper than the skin and appears faded, the priest will then quarantine him for seven days.

3074.label: Leviticus 13:22
3074.text: And if it has clearly spread on the skin, the priest will then declare him unclean. It is a disease.

3075.label: Leviticus 13:23
3075.text: But if the blotch stays in one place and has not spread, it is only the inflammation from the boil, and the priest will declare him clean.

3076.label: Leviticus 13:24
3076.text: “Or if someone has a scar from the fire and the raw flesh of the scar becomes a reddish-white blotch or a white one,

3077.label: Leviticus 13:25
3077.text: the priest will then examine it. If the hair in the blotch has turned white and it appears to be deeper than the skin, it is leprosy that has broken out in the scar, and the priest will declare him unclean. It is the disease of leprosy.

3078.label: Leviticus 13:26
3078.text: But if the priest examines it and sees that there is no white hair in the blotch and it is not deeper than the skin and it is faded, the priest will then quarantine him for seven days.

3079.label: Leviticus 13:27
3079.text: The priest will examine him on the seventh day, and if it has clearly spread on the skin, the priest will then declare him unclean. It is the disease of leprosy.

3080.label: Leviticus 13:28
3080.text: But if the blotch stays in one place and has not spread over the skin and it is faded, it is only a swelling of the scar, and the priest will declare him clean, because it is an inflammation of the scar.

3081.label: Leviticus 13:29
3081.text: “When a man or a woman develops an infection on the head or on the chin,

3082.label: Leviticus 13:30
3082.text: the priest will then examine the infection. If it appears to be deeper than the skin and the hair is yellow and thin, the priest will then declare such one unclean; it is an infection of the scalp or the beard. It is leprosy of the head or of the chin.

3083.label: Leviticus 13:31
3083.text: But if the priest sees that the infection does not appear to be deeper than the skin and there is no black hair in it, the priest should quarantine the infected person for seven days.

3084.label: Leviticus 13:32
3084.text: The priest will examine the infection on the seventh day, and if the infected area has not spread and no yellow hair has developed in it and the appearance of the infected area is not deeper than the skin,

3085.label: Leviticus 13:33
3085.text: the person should have himself shaved, but he will not have the infected area shaved. Then the priest will quarantine the infected person for seven days.

3086.label: Leviticus 13:34
3086.text: “The priest will again examine the infected area on the seventh day, and if the infection of the scalp and beard has not spread on the skin and it does not appear deeper than the skin, the priest must then declare him clean, and he should wash his garments and be clean.

3087.label: Leviticus 13:35
3087.text: But if the infection clearly spreads on the skin after his purification,

3088.label: Leviticus 13:36
3088.text: the priest will examine him, and if the infection has spread on the skin, the priest does not need to look for yellow hair; that person is unclean.

3089.label: Leviticus 13:37
3089.text: But if the examination shows that the infection has not spread and black hair has grown on it, the infection has been healed. He is clean, and the priest will declare him clean.

3090.label: Leviticus 13:38
3090.text: “If a man or a woman develops blotches on the skin and the blotches are white,

3091.label: Leviticus 13:39
3091.text: the priest will examine them. If the skin blotches are faded white, it is a harmless rash that has broken out on the skin. That person is clean.

3092.label: Leviticus 13:40
3092.text: “If a man loses the hair of his head and becomes bald, he is clean.

3093.label: Leviticus 13:41
3093.text: If he loses the hair on the front of his head and becomes bald there, he is clean.

3094.label: Leviticus 13:42
3094.text: But if a reddish-white sore develops on the bald part of his scalp or on his forehead, it is leprosy breaking out on his scalp or on his forehead.

3095.label: Leviticus 13:43
3095.text: The priest will examine him, and if the swelling from the infection is reddish-white on the bald spot on top of his head or on his forehead and it looks like leprosy on his skin,

3096.label: Leviticus 13:44
3096.text: he is a leper. He is unclean, and the priest should declare him unclean because of the disease on his head.

3097.label: Leviticus 13:45
3097.text: As for the leper who has the disease, his garments should be torn and his head should be left ungroomed and he should cover over his mustache and call out, ‘Unclean, unclean!’

3098.label: Leviticus 13:46
3098.text: He will be unclean the whole time that he has the disease. Since he is unclean, he should live in isolation. His dwelling place will be outside the camp.

3099.label: Leviticus 13:47
3099.text: “If the disease of leprosy contaminates a garment, whether a woolen or a linen garment,

3100.label: Leviticus 13:48
3100.text: either in the warp or in the woof of the linen or of the wool, or in a skin or in anything made of skin,

3101.label: Leviticus 13:49
3101.text: and the yellowish-green or reddish stain from the disease contaminates the garment, a skin, the warp, the woof, or any article of skin, it is a contamination from leprosy, and it should be shown to the priest.

3102.label: Leviticus 13:50
3102.text: The priest will examine the disease, and he must quarantine the disease for seven days.

3103.label: Leviticus 13:51
3103.text: When he examines the disease on the seventh day and sees that it has spread in the garment, in the warp, in the woof, or in the skin (regardless of what the skin is used for), the disease is malignant leprosy, and it is unclean.

3104.label: Leviticus 13:52
3104.text: He should burn the garment or the warp or the woof in the wool or in the linen or any article of skin in which the disease has developed, for it is malignant leprosy. It should be burned in the fire.

3105.label: Leviticus 13:53
3105.text: “But if the priest examines it and the disease has not spread in the garment or in the warp or in the woof or in any article of skin,

3106.label: Leviticus 13:54
3106.text: the priest will then command that they should wash the contaminated item, and he will quarantine it for another seven days.

3107.label: Leviticus 13:55
3107.text: The priest will then examine the contaminated item after it has been thoroughly washed. If the appearance of the contamination has not changed, even if the disease has not spread, it is unclean. You should burn it in the fire because it has been eaten away, either from its underside or from its outside.

3108.label: Leviticus 13:56
3108.text: “But if the priest has examined it and the contaminated part is faded after it has been thoroughly washed, he will then tear it out of the garment or the skin or the warp or the woof.

3109.label: Leviticus 13:57
3109.text: However, if it still appears in another part of the garment or in the warp or in the woof or in any article of skin, it is spreading, and you should burn any contaminated item in the fire.

3110.label: Leviticus 13:58
3110.text: But when the contamination disappears from the garment or the warp or the woof or any article of skin that you wash, it should then be washed a second time, and it will be clean.

3111.label: Leviticus 13:59
3111.text: “This is the law of the disease of leprosy in a garment of wool or of linen, or in the warp or in the woof, or in any article of skin, for declaring it clean or unclean.”

3112.label: Leviticus 14:1
3112.text: Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

3113.label: Leviticus 14:2
3113.text: “This is to be the law of the leper on the day his purification is established, when he is to be brought to the priest.

3114.label: Leviticus 14:3
3114.text: The priest will go outside the camp and examine him. If the leper has been cured of the leprosy,

3115.label: Leviticus 14:4
3115.text: the priest will command him to bring two live clean birds, cedarwood, scarlet material, and hyssop for his cleansing.

3116.label: Leviticus 14:5
3116.text: The priest will command that the one bird be killed in an earthenware vessel over running water.

3117.label: Leviticus 14:6
3117.text: But he should take the living bird along with the cedarwood, the scarlet material, and the hyssop, and dip them together in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water.

3118.label: Leviticus 14:7
3118.text: Then he will spatter it seven times on the one cleansing himself from the leprosy and declare him clean, and he will set the living bird free in the open field.

3119.label: Leviticus 14:8
3119.text: “The one cleansing himself must wash his garments and shave off all his hair and bathe in water, and he will be clean. Afterward, he may come into the camp, but he will dwell outside his tent for seven days.

3120.label: Leviticus 14:9
3120.text: On the seventh day, he should shave off all the hair on his head and his chin and his eyebrows. After he shaves off all his hair, he will wash his garments and bathe himself in water, and he will be clean.

3121.label: Leviticus 14:10
3121.text: “On the eighth day, he will take two sound young rams, one sound female lamb in its first year, three tenths of an eʹphah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, and one log measure of oil;

3122.label: Leviticus 14:11
3122.text: and the priest who declares him clean will present the man who is cleansing himself, along with the offerings, before Jehovah at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

3123.label: Leviticus 14:12
3123.text: The priest will take the one young ram and offer it as a guilt offering together with the log measure of oil, and he will wave them back and forth as a wave offering before Jehovah.

3124.label: Leviticus 14:13
3124.text: Then he will slaughter the young ram in the place where the sin offering and the burnt offering are usually slaughtered, in a holy place, because, like the sin offering, the guilt offering belongs to the priest. It is something most holy.

3125.label: Leviticus 14:14
3125.text: “Then the priest will take some of the blood of the guilt offering, and the priest will put it on the right earlobe of the one cleansing himself and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

3126.label: Leviticus 14:15
3126.text: And the priest will take some of the log measure of oil and pour it into his own left palm.

3127.label: Leviticus 14:16
3127.text: The priest will then dip his right finger into the oil that is in his left palm and spatter some of the oil with his finger seven times before Jehovah.

3128.label: Leviticus 14:17
3128.text: Then the priest will put some of the remaining oil in his palm on the right earlobe of the one cleansing himself and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot over the blood of the guilt offering.

3129.label: Leviticus 14:18
3129.text: The priest will put what is left over of the oil in his palm on the head of the one cleansing himself, and the priest will make atonement for him before Jehovah.

3130.label: Leviticus 14:19
3130.text: “The priest will sacrifice the sin offering and make atonement for the one cleansing himself from his impurity, and afterward he will slaughter the burnt offering.

3131.label: Leviticus 14:20
3131.text: And the priest will offer up the burnt offering and the grain offering on the altar, and the priest will make atonement for him, and he will be clean.

3132.label: Leviticus 14:21
3132.text: “However, if he is poor and does not have enough means, he will then take one young ram as a guilt offering for a wave offering, in order to make atonement for himself, along with one tenth of an eʹphah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, a log measure of oil,

3133.label: Leviticus 14:22
3133.text: and two turtledoves or two young pigeons, according to his means. The one will serve as a sin offering, and the other as a burnt offering.

3134.label: Leviticus 14:23
3134.text: On the eighth day, he will bring them for establishing his purification to the priest at the entrance of the tent of meeting before Jehovah.

3135.label: Leviticus 14:24
3135.text: “The priest will take the young ram of the guilt offering and the log measure of oil, and the priest will wave them back and forth as a wave offering before Jehovah.

3136.label: Leviticus 14:25
3136.text: He will then slaughter the young ram of the guilt offering, and the priest will take some of the blood of the guilt offering and put it on the right earlobe of the one cleansing himself and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

3137.label: Leviticus 14:26
3137.text: The priest will pour some of the oil into his own left palm,

3138.label: Leviticus 14:27
3138.text: and he will then spatter with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left palm seven times before Jehovah.

3139.label: Leviticus 14:28
3139.text: And the priest will put some of the oil that is in his palm on the right earlobe of the one cleansing himself and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot on the same places that he put the blood of the guilt offering.

3140.label: Leviticus 14:29
3140.text: The priest will then put what is left over of the oil in his palm on the head of the one cleansing himself, in order to make atonement for him before Jehovah.

3141.label: Leviticus 14:30
3141.text: “He will offer up one of the turtledoves or one of the young pigeons, according to his means,

3142.label: Leviticus 14:31
3142.text: the one he can afford, as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering along with the grain offering; and the priest will make atonement for the one cleansing himself before Jehovah.

3143.label: Leviticus 14:32
3143.text: “This is the law for the one in whom the disease of leprosy was but who does not have the means when establishing his purification.”

3144.label: Leviticus 14:33
3144.text: Then Jehovah said to Moses and Aaron:

3145.label: Leviticus 14:34
3145.text: “When you come into the land of Caʹnaan, which I am giving you as a possession, and I contaminate a house in your land with the disease of leprosy,

3146.label: Leviticus 14:35
3146.text: the one to whom the house belongs should then come and tell the priest, ‘Some kind of contamination has appeared in my house.’

3147.label: Leviticus 14:36
3147.text: The priest will give orders to clear out the house before he comes to examine the contamination, in order that he may not declare everything that is in the house unclean; and after that the priest will come in to inspect the house.

3148.label: Leviticus 14:37
3148.text: He will examine the affected area, and if the walls of the house are contaminated with yellowish-green or reddish depressions and they appear to be deeper than the wall surface,

3149.label: Leviticus 14:38
3149.text: the priest will then go out of the house to the entryway of the house and quarantine the house for seven days.

3150.label: Leviticus 14:39
3150.text: “Then the priest will return on the seventh day and make an inspection. If the contamination has spread in the walls of the house,

3151.label: Leviticus 14:40
3151.text: the priest will then give orders, and the contaminated stones must be torn out and thrown outside the city into an unclean place.

3152.label: Leviticus 14:41
3152.text: Then he is to have the inside of the house thoroughly scraped, and the plaster and mortar that is removed should be discarded outside the city in an unclean place.

3153.label: Leviticus 14:42
3153.text: They will then insert other stones in the place of the stones they removed, and he should use different mortar and have the house plastered.

3154.label: Leviticus 14:43
3154.text: “If, though, the contamination returns and breaks out in the house after the stones were torn out and the house was scraped and replastered,

3155.label: Leviticus 14:44
3155.text: the priest will then go in and inspect it. If the contamination has spread in the house, it is malignant leprosy in the house. The house is unclean.

3156.label: Leviticus 14:45
3156.text: He will then have the house pulled down—its stones, its timbers, and all the plaster and mortar of the house—and carried outside the city to an unclean place.

3157.label: Leviticus 14:46
3157.text: But whoever enters the house any of the days it is quarantined will be unclean until the evening;

3158.label: Leviticus 14:47
3158.text: and whoever lies down in the house should wash his garments, and whoever eats in the house should wash his garments.

3159.label: Leviticus 14:48
3159.text: “However, if the priest comes and sees that the contamination has not spread in the house after the house was replastered, the priest will then declare the house clean, because the contamination has been healed.

3160.label: Leviticus 14:49
3160.text: In order to purify the house from uncleanness, he will take two birds, cedarwood, scarlet material, and hyssop.

3161.label: Leviticus 14:50
3161.text: He is to kill the one bird in an earthenware vessel over running water.

3162.label: Leviticus 14:51
3162.text: Then he will take the cedarwood, the hyssop, the scarlet material, and the live bird and dip them in the blood of the bird that was killed and in the running water, and he must spatter it toward the house seven times.

3163.label: Leviticus 14:52
3163.text: And he will purify the house from uncleanness with the blood of the bird, the running water, the live bird, the cedarwood, the hyssop, and the scarlet material.

3164.label: Leviticus 14:53
3164.text: He will then set the live bird free outside the city in the open field and make atonement for the house, and it will be clean.

3165.label: Leviticus 14:54
3165.text: “This is the law respecting any case of leprosy, infection of the scalp or the beard,

3166.label: Leviticus 14:55
3166.text: leprosy of the garment or the house,

3167.label: Leviticus 14:56
3167.text: and respecting swellings, scabs, and blotches,

3168.label: Leviticus 14:57
3168.text: in order to determine when something is unclean and when something is clean. This is the law about leprosy.”

3169.label: Leviticus 15:1
3169.text: Jehovah continued to speak to Moses and Aaron, saying:

3170.label: Leviticus 15:2
3170.text: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them, ‘If a man has a discharge from his genital organ, this discharge makes him unclean.

3171.label: Leviticus 15:3
3171.text: He is unclean from the discharge, whether the discharge continues to flow from his genitals or is obstructed, he is still unclean.

3172.label: Leviticus 15:4
3172.text: “‘Any bed that the one with the discharge lies on will be unclean, and anything he sits on will be unclean.

3173.label: Leviticus 15:5
3173.text: A man who touches his bed must wash his garments, and he should bathe in water and be unclean until the evening.

3174.label: Leviticus 15:6
3174.text: Anyone who sits on an article that the one having a discharge sat on should wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening.

3175.label: Leviticus 15:7
3175.text: Whoever touches the flesh of the one having a discharge should wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening.

3176.label: Leviticus 15:8
