3176.text: If the one who has a discharge spits on someone clean, that person must wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening.

3177.label: Leviticus 15:9
3177.text: Any saddle that the one with the discharge rides on will be unclean.

3178.label: Leviticus 15:10
3178.text: Anyone touching anything that was under him will be unclean until the evening, and anyone who carries those items will wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening.

3179.label: Leviticus 15:11
3179.text: If the one with the discharge has not washed his hands in water and he touches someone, that person must then wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening.

3180.label: Leviticus 15:12
3180.text: An earthenware vessel that the one having a discharge touches should be smashed, and any wooden vessel should be washed with water.

3181.label: Leviticus 15:13
3181.text: “‘When the discharge stops and the person becomes clean from it, he will then count seven days for his purification, and he must wash his garments, bathe himself in running water, and he will be clean.

3182.label: Leviticus 15:14
3182.text: On the eighth day, he should take two turtledoves or two young pigeons and come before Jehovah at the entrance of the tent of meeting and give them to the priest.

3183.label: Leviticus 15:15
3183.text: And the priest will offer them, the one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, and the priest will make atonement for him before Jehovah concerning his discharge.

3184.label: Leviticus 15:16
3184.text: “‘Now if a man has an emission of semen, he should bathe his whole body in water and be unclean until the evening.

3185.label: Leviticus 15:17
3185.text: He must wash with water any garment and any skin with semen on it, and it will be unclean until the evening.

3186.label: Leviticus 15:18
3186.text: “‘When a man lies with a woman and has an emission of semen, they should bathe in water and be unclean until the evening.

3187.label: Leviticus 15:19
3187.text: “‘If a woman has a discharge of blood from her body, she will continue in her menstrual impurity for seven days. Anyone touching her will be unclean until the evening.

3188.label: Leviticus 15:20
3188.text: Anything she lies down on in her menstrual impurity will be unclean, and everything she sits on will be unclean.

3189.label: Leviticus 15:21
3189.text: Anyone touching her bed should wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening.

3190.label: Leviticus 15:22
3190.text: Anyone touching any article she sat on should wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening.

3191.label: Leviticus 15:23
3191.text: If she sat on the bed or on another article, his touching it will make him unclean until the evening.

3192.label: Leviticus 15:24
3192.text: And if a man lies down with her and her menstrual impurity comes on him, he will then be unclean for seven days, and any bed on which he lies down will be unclean.

3193.label: Leviticus 15:25
3193.text: “‘When a woman’s discharge of blood flows for many days when it is not the regular time of her menstruation, or if she should have a flow longer than her usual menstruation, she will be unclean during all the days of her discharge, as in the days of her menstrual impurity.

3194.label: Leviticus 15:26
3194.text: Any bed she lies on during the days of her discharge will become like the bed of her menstrual impurity, and any article she sits on will become unclean like the uncleanness of her menstrual impurity.

3195.label: Leviticus 15:27
3195.text: Anyone touching them will be unclean, and he must wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until the evening.

3196.label: Leviticus 15:28
3196.text: “‘However, when she is clean from her discharge, she will count for herself seven days, and afterward she will be clean.

3197.label: Leviticus 15:29
3197.text: On the eighth day, she should take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and she will bring them to the priest at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

3198.label: Leviticus 15:30
3198.text: The priest will make the one a sin offering and the other a burnt offering, and the priest will make atonement for her before Jehovah concerning her unclean discharge.

3199.label: Leviticus 15:31
3199.text: “‘Thus you must keep the Israelites separate from their uncleanness, so that they do not die in their uncleanness by defiling my tabernacle, which is in their midst.

3200.label: Leviticus 15:32
3200.text: “‘This is the law about the man having a discharge, the man who is unclean because of an emission of semen,

3201.label: Leviticus 15:33
3201.text: the woman during her menstrual impurity, any male or female who has a discharge flowing from the body, and a man who lies down with an unclean woman.’”

3202.label: Leviticus 16:1
3202.text: Jehovah spoke to Moses after the death of Aaron’s two sons who died for approaching Jehovah.

3203.label: Leviticus 16:2
3203.text: Jehovah said to Moses: “Tell Aaron your brother that he may not come at just any time into the holy place inside the curtain, in front of the cover on the Ark, so that he may not die, for I will appear over the cover in a cloud.

3204.label: Leviticus 16:3
3204.text: “This is what Aaron should bring when he comes into the holy place: a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

3205.label: Leviticus 16:4
3205.text: He should put on the holy linen robe, and the linen shorts should cover his body, and he should wrap himself with the linen sash and his head with the linen turban. They are holy garments. He will bathe himself in water and put them on.

3206.label: Leviticus 16:5
3206.text: “He should take from the assembly of the Israelites two young male goats for a sin offering and one ram for a burnt offering.

3207.label: Leviticus 16:6
3207.text: “Aaron must then present the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and he will make atonement in behalf of himself and his house.

3208.label: Leviticus 16:7
3208.text: “He will then take the two goats and make them stand before Jehovah at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

3209.label: Leviticus 16:8
3209.text: Aaron will draw lots over the two goats, the one lot for Jehovah and the other lot for A·zaʹzel.

3210.label: Leviticus 16:9
3210.text: Aaron will present the goat that was designated by lot for Jehovah and make it a sin offering.

3211.label: Leviticus 16:10
3211.text: But the goat designated by lot for A·zaʹzel should be brought alive to stand before Jehovah in order to perform the atonement upon it, so that it may be sent away for A·zaʹzel into the wilderness.

3212.label: Leviticus 16:11
3212.text: “Aaron will present the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement in behalf of himself and his house; afterward he will slaughter the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself.

3213.label: Leviticus 16:12
3213.text: “He will then take the fire holder full of burning coals from the altar before Jehovah and two handfuls of fine perfumed incense, and he will bring them inside the curtain.

3214.label: Leviticus 16:13
3214.text: He will also put the incense on the fire before Jehovah, and the cloud of the incense will envelop the Ark cover, which is on the Testimony, so that he may not die.

3215.label: Leviticus 16:14
3215.text: “He will take some of the bull’s blood and spatter it with his finger in front of the cover on the east side, and he will spatter some of the blood with his finger seven times before the cover.

3216.label: Leviticus 16:15
3216.text: “He will then slaughter the goat of the sin offering, which is for the people, and bring its blood inside the curtain and do with its blood the same as he did with the bull’s blood; he is to spatter it toward the cover and before the cover.

3217.label: Leviticus 16:16
3217.text: “He must make atonement for the holy place concerning the acts of uncleanness of the Israelites and concerning their transgressions and their sins, and that is what he should do for the tent of meeting, which is located among them in the midst of their acts of uncleanness.

3218.label: Leviticus 16:17
3218.text: “No other man should be in the tent of meeting from the time he goes in to make atonement in the holy place until he comes out. He will make atonement in behalf of himself and his house and in behalf of the entire congregation of Israel.

3219.label: Leviticus 16:18
3219.text: “He will then come out to the altar, which is before Jehovah, and make atonement for it, and he will take some of the bull’s blood and some of the goat’s blood and put it on the horns of the altar on all sides.

3220.label: Leviticus 16:19
3220.text: He will also spatter some of the blood on it with his finger seven times and cleanse it and sanctify it from the acts of uncleanness of the Israelites.

3221.label: Leviticus 16:20
3221.text: “When he has finished making atonement for the holy place and the tent of meeting and the altar, he will also present the live goat.

3222.label: Leviticus 16:21
3222.text: Aaron will lay both his hands on the head of the live goat and confess over it all the errors of the Israelites and all their transgressions and all their sins, and he will put them on the head of the goat and send it away into the wilderness by the hand of a man designated to do this.

3223.label: Leviticus 16:22
3223.text: The goat will carry upon itself all their errors into a desert land, and he will send the goat away into the wilderness.

3224.label: Leviticus 16:23
3224.text: “Aaron will then enter into the tent of meeting and take off the linen garments that he put on when he went into the holy place, and he will lay them down there.

3225.label: Leviticus 16:24
3225.text: He must bathe himself in water in a holy place and put on his garments; then he will come out and offer up his burnt offering and the people’s burnt offering and make atonement in his own behalf and in behalf of the people.

3226.label: Leviticus 16:25
3226.text: He will make the fat of the sin offering smoke on the altar.

3227.label: Leviticus 16:26
3227.text: “The man who sent away the goat for A·zaʹzel should wash his garments and bathe himself in water, and after that he may come into the camp.

3228.label: Leviticus 16:27
3228.text: “And the bull of the sin offering and the goat of the sin offering, whose blood was brought into the holy place to make atonement, will be taken outside the camp, and their skins and their flesh and their dung will be burned in the fire.

3229.label: Leviticus 16:28
3229.text: The one who burns them should wash his garments and bathe himself in water, and after that he may come into the camp.

3230.label: Leviticus 16:29
3230.text: “It will serve as a lasting statute for you: In the seventh month, on the tenth of the month, you should afflict yourselves, and you must not do any work, whether a native or a foreigner who is residing among you.

3231.label: Leviticus 16:30
3231.text: On this day atonement will be made for you, to declare you clean. You will be clean from all your sins before Jehovah.

3232.label: Leviticus 16:31
3232.text: It is a sabbath of complete rest for you, and you should afflict yourselves. It is a lasting statute.

3233.label: Leviticus 16:32
3233.text: “The priest who is anointed and installed to serve as priest in place of his father will make atonement and put on the linen garments, the holy garments.

3234.label: Leviticus 16:33
3234.text: He will make atonement for the holy sanctuary, the tent of meeting, and the altar; and he will make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the congregation.

3235.label: Leviticus 16:34
3235.text: This will serve as a lasting statute for you, to make atonement for the Israelites concerning all their sins once each year.” So he did just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

3236.label: Leviticus 17:1
3236.text: Jehovah went on to say to Moses:

3237.label: Leviticus 17:2
3237.text: “Speak to Aaron and his sons and all the Israelites and say to them, ‘This is what Jehovah has commanded:

3238.label: Leviticus 17:3
3238.text: “‘“If any man of the house of Israel slaughters a bull or a young ram or a goat in the camp or if he slaughters it outside the camp,

3239.label: Leviticus 17:4
3239.text: instead of bringing it to the entrance of the tent of meeting to present it as an offering to Jehovah before the tabernacle of Jehovah, bloodguilt will be counted to that man. He has shed blood, and that man must be cut off from among his people.

3240.label: Leviticus 17:5
3240.text: This is so that the Israelites will bring the sacrifices, which they now sacrifice in the open field, to Jehovah, to the entrance of the tent of meeting, to the priest. They are to sacrifice these as communion sacrifices to Jehovah.

3241.label: Leviticus 17:6
3241.text: And the priest will sprinkle the blood on Jehovah’s altar at the entrance of the tent of meeting and make the fat smoke as a pleasing aroma to Jehovah.

3242.label: Leviticus 17:7
3242.text: So they should no longer offer sacrifices to the goatlike demons, with which they are prostituting themselves. This will serve as a lasting statute for you throughout your generations.”’

3243.label: Leviticus 17:8
3243.text: “You should say to them, ‘Any man of the house of Israel or any foreigner who is residing in your midst who offers up a burnt offering or a sacrifice

3244.label: Leviticus 17:9
3244.text: and does not bring it to the entrance of the tent of meeting to offer it to Jehovah must be cut off from his people.

3245.label: Leviticus 17:10
3245.text: “‘If any man of the house of Israel or any foreigner who is residing in your midst eats any sort of blood, I will certainly set my face against the one who is eating the blood, and I will cut him off from among his people.

3246.label: Leviticus 17:11
3246.text: For the life of the flesh is in the blood, and I myself have given it on the altar for you to make atonement for yourselves, because it is the blood that makes atonement by means of the life in it.

3247.label: Leviticus 17:12
3247.text: That is why I have said to the Israelites: “None of you should eat blood, and no foreigner who is residing in your midst should eat blood.”

3248.label: Leviticus 17:13
3248.text: “‘If one of the Israelites or some foreigner who is residing in your midst is hunting and catches a wild animal or a bird that may be eaten, he must pour its blood out and cover it with dust.

3249.label: Leviticus 17:14
3249.text: For the life of every sort of flesh is its blood, because the life is in it. Consequently, I said to the Israelites: “You must not eat the blood of any sort of flesh because the life of every sort of flesh is its blood. Anyone eating it will be cut off.”

3250.label: Leviticus 17:15
3250.text: If anyone, whether a native or a foreigner, eats an animal found dead or one torn by a wild animal, he must then wash his garments and bathe in water and be unclean until the evening; then he will be clean.

3251.label: Leviticus 17:16
3251.text: But if he does not wash them and does not bathe himself, he will answer for his error.’”

3252.label: Leviticus 18:1
3252.text: Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

3253.label: Leviticus 18:2
3253.text: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them, ‘I am Jehovah your God.

3254.label: Leviticus 18:3
3254.text: You must not behave as they do in the land of Egypt, where you were dwelling, and you must not do what they do in the land of Caʹnaan, where I am bringing you. And you must not walk in their statutes.

3255.label: Leviticus 18:4
3255.text: You should carry out my judicial decisions, and you should keep my statutes and walk in them. I am Jehovah your God.

3256.label: Leviticus 18:5
3256.text: You must keep my statutes and my judicial decisions; anyone who does so will live by means of them. I am Jehovah.

3257.label: Leviticus 18:6
3257.text: “‘No man among you should approach any of his close relatives to have sexual relations. I am Jehovah.

3258.label: Leviticus 18:7
3258.text: You must not have sexual relations with your father, and you must not have sexual relations with your mother. She is your mother, and you must not have sexual relations with her.

3259.label: Leviticus 18:8
3259.text: “‘You must not have sexual relations with your father’s wife. It is exposing your father to shame.

3260.label: Leviticus 18:9
3260.text: “‘You must not have sexual relations with your sister, either the daughter of your father or the daughter of your mother, whether she is born in the same household or born outside of it.

3261.label: Leviticus 18:10
3261.text: “‘You must not have sexual relations with the daughter of your son or the daughter of your daughter, because they are your own nakedness.

3262.label: Leviticus 18:11
3262.text: “‘You must not have sexual relations with the daughter of your father’s wife, the offspring of your father, because she is your sister.

3263.label: Leviticus 18:12
3263.text: “‘You must not have sexual relations with your father’s sister. She is your father’s blood relative.

3264.label: Leviticus 18:13
3264.text: “‘You must not have sexual relations with your mother’s sister, because she is your mother’s blood relative.

3265.label: Leviticus 18:14
3265.text: “‘You must not expose your father’s brother to shame by having sexual relations with his wife. She is your aunt.

3266.label: Leviticus 18:15
3266.text: “‘You must not have sexual relations with your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife, and you must not have relations with her.

3267.label: Leviticus 18:16
3267.text: “‘You must not have sexual relations with your brother’s wife, because it is exposing your brother to shame.

3268.label: Leviticus 18:17
3268.text: “‘You must not have sexual relations with a woman and her daughter. You must not take the daughter of her son and the daughter of her daughter in order to have relations. They are her close relatives; it is an obscene act.

3269.label: Leviticus 18:18
3269.text: “‘You must not take a woman in addition to her sister as a rival wife and have sexual relations with her while her sister is alive.

3270.label: Leviticus 18:19
3270.text: “‘You must not approach a woman during her menstrual impurity to have sexual relations with her.

3271.label: Leviticus 18:20
3271.text: “‘You must not have sexual intercourse with the wife of your fellow man, making yourself unclean.

3272.label: Leviticus 18:21
3272.text: “‘You must not allow any of your offspring to be offered to Moʹlech. You must not profane the name of your God in that way. I am Jehovah.

3273.label: Leviticus 18:22
3273.text: “‘You must not lie down with a male in the same way that you lie down with a woman. It is a detestable act.

3274.label: Leviticus 18:23
3274.text: “‘A man must not have sexual intercourse with an animal to become unclean by it; nor should a woman offer herself to an animal to have intercourse with it. It is a violation of what is natural.

3275.label: Leviticus 18:24
3275.text: “‘Do not make yourselves unclean by any of these things, for it is by all these things that the nations that I am driving out from before you have made themselves unclean.

3276.label: Leviticus 18:25
3276.text: Therefore, the land is unclean, and I will bring punishment on it for its error, and the land will vomit its inhabitants out.

3277.label: Leviticus 18:26
3277.text: But you yourselves must keep my statutes and my judicial decisions, and you must not do any of these detestable things, whether a native or a foreigner who is residing among you.

3278.label: Leviticus 18:27
3278.text: For all these detestable things were done by the men who lived in the land before you, and now the land is unclean.

3279.label: Leviticus 18:28
3279.text: Then the land will not have to vomit you out for defiling it in the same way that it will vomit out the nations that were before you.

3280.label: Leviticus 18:29
3280.text: If anyone does any of these detestable things, all those doing them must be cut off from among their people.

3281.label: Leviticus 18:30
3281.text: You must keep your obligation to me by not practicing any of the detestable customs that were carried on before you, so that you do not make yourselves unclean by them. I am Jehovah your God.’”

3282.label: Leviticus 19:1
3282.text: Jehovah spoke further to Moses, saying:

3283.label: Leviticus 19:2
3283.text: “Speak to the entire assembly of the Israelites and tell them, ‘You should be holy, because I, Jehovah your God, am holy.

3284.label: Leviticus 19:3
3284.text: “‘Each of you should respect his mother and his father, and you should keep my sabbaths. I am Jehovah your God.

3285.label: Leviticus 19:4
3285.text: Do not turn to worthless gods or make for yourselves gods of cast metal. I am Jehovah your God.

3286.label: Leviticus 19:5
3286.text: “‘Now if you offer a communion sacrifice to Jehovah, you should sacrifice it in such a way that you gain approval for yourselves.

3287.label: Leviticus 19:6
3287.text: It should be eaten on the day of your sacrifice and on the next day, but what is left over until the third day should be burned in the fire.

3288.label: Leviticus 19:7
3288.text: If, though, any of it is eaten on the third day, it is an offensive thing that will not be accepted with approval.

3289.label: Leviticus 19:8
3289.text: The one eating it will answer for his error because he has profaned a holy thing of Jehovah, and that person must be cut off from his people.

3290.label: Leviticus 19:9
3290.text: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you must not reap the edge of your field completely and you must not pick up the gleaning of your harvest.

3291.label: Leviticus 19:10
3291.text: Also, you must not gather the leftovers of your vineyard or pick up the scattered grapes of your vineyard. You should leave them for the poor and the foreign resident. I am Jehovah your God.

3292.label: Leviticus 19:11
3292.text: “‘You must not steal, you must not deceive, and you must not deal falsely with one another.

3293.label: Leviticus 19:12
3293.text: You must not swear to a lie in my name and thus profane the name of your God. I am Jehovah.

3294.label: Leviticus 19:13
3294.text: You must not defraud your fellow man, and you must not rob. You should not withhold the wages of a hired worker all night until morning.

3295.label: Leviticus 19:14
3295.text: “‘You must not curse a deaf man or put an obstacle before a blind man, and you must be in fear of your God. I am Jehovah.

3296.label: Leviticus 19:15
3296.text: “‘You must not be unjust in your judgment. You must not show partiality to the poor or show preference to the rich. With justice you should judge your fellow man.

3297.label: Leviticus 19:16
3297.text: “‘You must not go around spreading slander among your people. You must not stand up against the life of your fellow man. I am Jehovah.

3298.label: Leviticus 19:17
3298.text: “‘You must not hate your brother in your heart. You should by all means reprove your fellow man, so that you will not bear sin along with him.

3299.label: Leviticus 19:18
3299.text: “‘You must not take vengeance nor hold a grudge against the sons of your people, and you must love your fellow man as yourself. I am Jehovah.

3300.label: Leviticus 19:19
3300.text: “‘You should keep my statutes: You must not interbreed two sorts of your domestic animals. You must not sow your field with two sorts of seed, and you must not wear a garment made with two sorts of thread mixed together.

3301.label: Leviticus 19:20
3301.text: “‘Now if a man lies down with a woman and has intercourse with her and she is a servant who is designated for another man, but she has not been redeemed or given her freedom, there should be a punishment. However, they should not be put to death, for she was not yet set free.

3302.label: Leviticus 19:21
3302.text: He should bring his guilt offering to Jehovah to the entrance of the tent of meeting, a ram of guilt offering.

3303.label: Leviticus 19:22
3303.text: The priest will make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt offering before Jehovah for the sin that he committed, and he will be forgiven for the sin that he committed.

3304.label: Leviticus 19:23
3304.text: “‘When you come into the land and you plant any tree for food, you must consider its fruitage impure and forbidden. For three years it will be forbidden to you. It must not be eaten.

3305.label: Leviticus 19:24
3305.text: But in the fourth year, all its fruit will be holy for rejoicing before Jehovah.

3306.label: Leviticus 19:25
3306.text: Then in the fifth year, you may eat its fruit in order to add its produce to your harvest. I am Jehovah your God.

3307.label: Leviticus 19:26
3307.text: “‘You must eat nothing containing blood. “‘You must not look for omens or practice magic.

3308.label: Leviticus 19:27
3308.text: “‘You must not shave the hair on the side of your head or disfigure the edges of your beard.

3309.label: Leviticus 19:28
3309.text: “‘You must not make cuts in your flesh for a dead person, and you must not make tattoo markings on yourselves. I am Jehovah.

3310.label: Leviticus 19:29
3310.text: “‘Do not dishonor your daughter by making her a prostitute, so that the land may not commit prostitution and be filled with loose morals.

3311.label: Leviticus 19:30
3311.text: “‘You must keep my sabbaths, and you must show reverence for my sanctuary. I am Jehovah.

3312.label: Leviticus 19:31
3312.text: “‘Do not turn to the spirit mediums, and do not consult fortune-tellers so as to become unclean by them. I am Jehovah your God.

3313.label: Leviticus 19:32
3313.text: “‘Before gray hair you should rise up, and you must show honor to an older man, and you must be in fear of your God. I am Jehovah.

3314.label: Leviticus 19:33
3314.text: “‘If a foreigner resides with you in your land, you must not mistreat him.

3315.label: Leviticus 19:34
3315.text: The foreigner who resides with you should become to you like a native among you; and you must love him as yourself, for you were foreign residents in the land of Egypt. I am Jehovah your God.

3316.label: Leviticus 19:35
3316.text: “‘You must not use dishonest standards in measuring length, weight, or volume.

3317.label: Leviticus 19:36
3317.text: You should use accurate scales, accurate weights, an accurate dry measure, and an accurate liquid measure. I am Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

3318.label: Leviticus 19:37
3318.text: So you must keep all my statutes and all my judicial decisions, and you must follow them. I am Jehovah.’”

3319.label: Leviticus 20:1
3319.text: Jehovah went on speaking to Moses, saying:

3320.label: Leviticus 20:2
3320.text: “You are to say to the Israelites, ‘Any man of Israel and any foreigner who resides in Israel who gives any of his offspring to Moʹlech should be put to death without fail. The people of the land should stone him to death.

3321.label: Leviticus 20:3
3321.text: I myself will set my face against that man, and I will cut him off from among his people, because he has given some of his offspring to Moʹlech and has defiled my holy place and has profaned my holy name.

3322.label: Leviticus 20:4
3322.text: If the people of the land should deliberately close their eyes to what that man does when he gives his offspring to Moʹlech and they do not put him to death,

3323.label: Leviticus 20:5
3323.text: then I myself will certainly set my face against that man and his family. I will cut off that man from his people along with all who join him in prostituting themselves to Moʹlech.

3324.label: Leviticus 20:6
3324.text: “‘As for the person who turns to the spirit mediums and the fortune-tellers so as to commit spiritual prostitution with them, I will certainly turn against that person and cut him off from his people.

3325.label: Leviticus 20:7
3325.text: “‘You must sanctify yourselves and become holy, because I am Jehovah your God.

3326.label: Leviticus 20:8
3326.text: And you must keep my statutes and carry them out. I am Jehovah, who is sanctifying you.

3327.label: Leviticus 20:9
3327.text: “‘If there is any man who curses his father or his mother, he should be put to death without fail. Since he has cursed his father or his mother, his own blood is upon him.

3328.label: Leviticus 20:10
3328.text: “‘Now regarding a man who commits adultery with another man’s wife: The one who commits adultery with the wife of his fellow man should be put to death without fail, the adulterer and the adulteress.

3329.label: Leviticus 20:11
3329.text: A man who lies down with his father’s wife has exposed his father to shame. Both of them should be put to death without fail. Their own blood is upon them.

3330.label: Leviticus 20:12
3330.text: If a man lies down with his daughter-in-law, both of them should be put to death without fail. They have violated what is natural. Their own blood is upon them.

3331.label: Leviticus 20:13
3331.text: “‘If a man lies down with a male the same as one lies down with a woman, both of them have done a detestable thing. They should be put to death without fail. Their own blood is upon them.

3332.label: Leviticus 20:14
3332.text: “‘If a man takes a woman and her mother, it is an obscene act. They should burn him and them in the fire, so that obscene conduct may not continue among you.

3333.label: Leviticus 20:15
3333.text: “‘If a man has intercourse with a beast, he should be put to death without fail, and you should kill the beast.

3334.label: Leviticus 20:16
3334.text: If a woman approaches any beast to have intercourse with it, you must kill the woman and the beast. They should be put to death without fail. Their own blood is upon them.

3335.label: Leviticus 20:17
3335.text: “‘If a man has sexual relations with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother, and he sees her nakedness and she sees his nakedness, it is a disgrace. They must be cut off before the eyes of the sons of their people. He has exposed his sister to shame. He should answer for his error.

3336.label: Leviticus 20:18
3336.text: “‘If a man lies down with a menstruating woman and has sexual relations with her, both he and she have exposed her flow of blood. Both of them must be cut off from among their people.

3337.label: Leviticus 20:19
3337.text: “‘You must not have sexual relations with your mother’s sister or your father’s sister, because that would be exposing a blood relative to shame. They should answer for their error.

3338.label: Leviticus 20:20
3338.text: A man who lies down with his uncle’s wife has exposed his uncle to shame. They should answer for their sin. They should die childless.

3339.label: Leviticus 20:21
3339.text: If a man takes his brother’s wife, it is something abhorrent. He has exposed his brother to shame. They should become childless.

3340.label: Leviticus 20:22
3340.text: “‘You must keep all my statutes and all my judicial decisions and carry them out, so that the land where I am bringing you to dwell will not vomit you out.

3341.label: Leviticus 20:23
3341.text: You must not walk in the statutes of the nations that I am driving out from before you; for they have done all these things and I abhor them.

3342.label: Leviticus 20:24
3342.text: That is why I said to you: “You will take possession of their land, and I will give it to you as your possession, a land flowing with milk and honey. Jehovah your God I am, who has set you apart from the peoples.”

3343.label: Leviticus 20:25
3343.text: You must make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean and between the unclean bird and the clean; you must not make yourselves loathsome by means of an animal or a bird or anything that creeps on the ground that I set apart for you to regard as unclean.

3344.label: Leviticus 20:26
3344.text: You must be holy to me, because I, Jehovah, am holy, and I am setting you apart from the peoples to become mine.

3345.label: Leviticus 20:27
3345.text: “‘Any man or woman who acts as a spirit medium or is a fortune-teller should be put to death without fail. The people should stone them to death. Their own blood is upon them.’”

3346.label: Leviticus 21:1
3346.text: Jehovah went on to say to Moses: “Talk to the priests, Aaron’s sons, and say to them, ‘No one should defile himself for a dead person among his people.

3347.label: Leviticus 21:2
3347.text: But he may do so for a close blood relative, for his mother, his father, his son, his daughter, his brother,

3348.label: Leviticus 21:3
3348.text: and he may defile himself for his sister if she is a virgin who is near to him and has not yet married.

3349.label: Leviticus 21:4
3349.text: He may not defile himself and make himself profane for a woman who belongs to a husband of his people.

3350.label: Leviticus 21:5
3350.text: They should not make their heads bald or shave off the fringe of their beard or make cuts on their body.

3351.label: Leviticus 21:6
3351.text: They should be holy to their God, and they should not profane the name of their God, for they are presenting Jehovah’s offerings made by fire, the bread of their God, and they must be holy.

3352.label: Leviticus 21:7
3352.text: They should not marry a prostitute, a woman who has been defiled, or a woman divorced from her husband, because the priest is holy to his God.

3353.label: Leviticus 21:8
3353.text: You must sanctify him, because he is one presenting the bread of your God. He should be holy to you, because I, Jehovah, the one sanctifying you, am holy.

3354.label: Leviticus 21:9
3354.text: “‘Now if the daughter of a priest should profane herself by committing prostitution, she is profaning her father. She should be burned in the fire.

3355.label: Leviticus 21:10
3355.text: “‘The high priest of his brothers, on whose head the anointing oil is poured and who has been installed to wear the priestly garments, should not let his head go ungroomed or tear his garments.

3356.label: Leviticus 21:11
3356.text: He should not approach any dead person; he may not defile himself even for his father or his mother.

3357.label: Leviticus 21:12
3357.text: He should not go out from the sanctuary and should not profane the sanctuary of his God, for the sign of dedication, the anointing oil of his God, is upon him. I am Jehovah.

3358.label: Leviticus 21:13
3358.text: “‘He must take as a wife a woman who is a virgin.

3359.label: Leviticus 21:14
3359.text: He may not marry a widow, a divorced woman, one who has been defiled, or a prostitute; but he should take a virgin from his people as a wife.

3360.label: Leviticus 21:15
3360.text: He should not profane his offspring among his people, for I am Jehovah, who is sanctifying him.’”

3361.label: Leviticus 21:16
3361.text: Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

3362.label: Leviticus 21:17
3362.text: “Tell Aaron, ‘No man of your offspring throughout their generations who has a defect may approach to present the bread of his God.

3363.label: Leviticus 21:18
3363.text: If there is any man who has a defect, he may not approach: a man who is blind or lame or has a disfigured face or one limb too long,

3364.label: Leviticus 21:19
3364.text: a man with a fractured foot or a fractured hand,

3365.label: Leviticus 21:20
3365.text: a hunchback or a dwarf, or a man with an eye defect or eczema or ringworm or damaged testicles.

3366.label: Leviticus 21:21
3366.text: No man of the offspring of Aaron the priest who has a defect may approach to present Jehovah’s offerings made by fire. Because he has a defect, he may not approach to present the bread of his God.

3367.label: Leviticus 21:22
3367.text: He may eat the bread of his God from the most holy things and from the holy things.

3368.label: Leviticus 21:23
3368.text: However, he may not come near the curtain, and he may not approach the altar, because there is a defect in him; and he should not profane my sanctuary, for I am Jehovah, who is sanctifying them.’”

3369.label: Leviticus 21:24
3369.text: So Moses spoke to Aaron and his sons and all the Israelites.

3370.label: Leviticus 22:1
3370.text: Jehovah spoke further to Moses, saying:

3371.label: Leviticus 22:2
3371.text: “Tell Aaron and his sons that they should be careful how they handle the holy things of the Israelites and not profane my holy name regarding the things they are sanctifying to me. I am Jehovah.

3372.label: Leviticus 22:3
3372.text: Say to them, ‘Throughout your generations, any of your offspring who, while he is unclean, comes near to the holy things that the Israelites sanctify to Jehovah, that person will be cut off from before me. I am Jehovah.

3373.label: Leviticus 22:4
3373.text: No man of Aaron’s offspring who has leprosy or a discharge may eat of the holy things until he becomes clean, neither the man who touches someone who became unclean by a dead person, nor a man who has a seminal emission,

3374.label: Leviticus 22:5
3374.text: nor a man who touches an unclean swarming creature or who touches a man who is unclean for any reason and who can make him unclean.

3375.label: Leviticus 22:6
3375.text: The person who touches any of these will be unclean until the evening and may not eat any of the holy things, but he should bathe himself in water.

3376.label: Leviticus 22:7
3376.text: When the sun has set, he will be clean, and afterward he may eat some of the holy things because it is his food.

3377.label: Leviticus 22:8
3377.text: Also, he should not eat any animal found dead or anything torn by wild animals and become unclean by it. I am Jehovah.

3378.label: Leviticus 22:9
3378.text: “‘They must keep their obligation to me, so that they may not incur sin because of it and have to die for it because they were profaning it. I am Jehovah, who is sanctifying them.

3379.label: Leviticus 22:10
3379.text: “‘No unauthorized person may eat anything holy. No foreign guest of a priest or hired worker may eat anything holy.

3380.label: Leviticus 22:11
3380.text: But if a priest should purchase someone with his own money, that person may share in eating it. Slaves born in his house may also share in eating his food.

3381.label: Leviticus 22:12
3381.text: If the daughter of a priest should marry someone who is not a priest, she may not eat of the contribution of the holy things.

3382.label: Leviticus 22:13
3382.text: But if the daughter of a priest should become a widow or is divorced and she has no offspring and she returns to her father’s house as in her youth, she may eat some of her father’s food; but no unauthorized person may eat it.

3383.label: Leviticus 22:14
3383.text: “‘Now if a man eats a holy thing by mistake, he must add a fifth of its value and give the holy offering to the priest.

3384.label: Leviticus 22:15
3384.text: So they should not profane the holy things of the Israelites that they contribute to Jehovah

3385.label: Leviticus 22:16
3385.text: and cause them to incur punishment for their guilt because of eating their holy things; for I am Jehovah, who is sanctifying them.’”

3386.label: Leviticus 22:17
3386.text: Jehovah continued speaking to Moses, saying:

3387.label: Leviticus 22:18
3387.text: “Speak to Aaron and his sons and all the Israelites and say to them, ‘When an Israelite man or a foreign resident in Israel presents a burnt offering to Jehovah to fulfill his vows or to make a voluntary offering,

3388.label: Leviticus 22:19
3388.text: he should present a sound male from the herd, the young rams, or the goats, in order to gain approval.

3389.label: Leviticus 22:20
3389.text: You must not present anything with a defect, for it will not serve to gain approval for you.

3390.label: Leviticus 22:21
3390.text: “‘If a man presents a communion sacrifice to Jehovah to pay a vow or as a voluntary offering, it should be a sound animal from the herd or the flock, in order to gain approval. No defect at all should be in it.

3391.label: Leviticus 22:22
3391.text: No offering should be blind, have a fracture, a cut, a wart, scabbiness, or ringworm; you must not present any of these to Jehovah or make such an offering on the altar for Jehovah.

3392.label: Leviticus 22:23
3392.text: You may present a bull or a sheep with a limb that is too long or too short as a voluntary offering, but it will not be accepted with approval as a vow offering.

3393.label: Leviticus 22:24
3393.text: You must not present to Jehovah one having the testicles damaged or crushed or pulled off or cut off, and you should not offer such animals in your land.

3394.label: Leviticus 22:25
3394.text: And you must not present any of these from the hand of a foreigner as the bread of your God, for they are corrupted and defective. They will not be accepted with approval for you.’”

3395.label: Leviticus 22:26
3395.text: Jehovah spoke further to Moses, saying:

3396.label: Leviticus 22:27
3396.text: “When a bull or a young ram or a goat is born, it will continue with its mother for seven days, but from the eighth day forward it will be accepted with approval as an offering, an offering made by fire to Jehovah.

3397.label: Leviticus 22:28
3397.text: As for a bull or a sheep, you must not slaughter it and its young on the same day.

3398.label: Leviticus 22:29
3398.text: “If you sacrifice a thanksgiving sacrifice to Jehovah, you should sacrifice it to gain approval for yourselves.

3399.label: Leviticus 22:30
3399.text: It should be eaten on that day. You must not leave any of it until morning. I am Jehovah.

3400.label: Leviticus 22:31
3400.text: “You must keep my commandments and carry them out. I am Jehovah.

3401.label: Leviticus 22:32
3401.text: You must not profane my holy name, and I must be sanctified in the midst of the Israelites. I am Jehovah, who is sanctifying you,

3402.label: Leviticus 22:33
3402.text: the one bringing you out of the land of Egypt to prove myself God to you. I am Jehovah.”

3403.label: Leviticus 23:1
3403.text: Jehovah continued speaking to Moses, saying:

3404.label: Leviticus 23:2
3404.text: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them, ‘The seasonal festivals of Jehovah that you should proclaim are holy conventions. These are my seasonal festivals:

3405.label: Leviticus 23:3
3405.text: “‘Six days work may be done, but on the seventh day is a sabbath of complete rest, a holy convention. You may not do any sort of work. It is to be a sabbath to Jehovah wherever you dwell.

3406.label: Leviticus 23:4
3406.text: “‘These are the seasonal festivals of Jehovah, holy conventions that you should proclaim at the times appointed for them:

3407.label: Leviticus 23:5
3407.text: In the first month, on the 14th day of the month, at twilight is the Passover to Jehovah.

3408.label: Leviticus 23:6
3408.text: “‘On the 15th day of this month is the Festival of Unleavened Bread to Jehovah. Seven days you should eat unleavened bread.

3409.label: Leviticus 23:7
3409.text: On the first day, you will observe a holy convention. You should not do any hard work.

3410.label: Leviticus 23:8
3410.text: But you are to present an offering made by fire to Jehovah for seven days. There will be a holy convention on the seventh day. You should not do any hard work.’”

3411.label: Leviticus 23:9
3411.text: Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

3412.label: Leviticus 23:10
3412.text: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them, ‘When you eventually come into the land that I am giving you and you have reaped its harvest, you must bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest to the priest.

3413.label: Leviticus 23:11
3413.text: And he will wave the sheaf back and forth before Jehovah to gain approval for you. The priest should wave it on the day after the Sabbath.

3414.label: Leviticus 23:12
3414.text: On the day you have the sheaf waved, you must offer a sound young ram in its first year, as a burnt offering to Jehovah.

3415.label: Leviticus 23:13
3415.text: Its grain offering will be two tenths of an eʹphah of fine flour mixed with oil, as an offering made by fire to Jehovah, a pleasing aroma. Its drink offering will be a fourth of a hin of wine.

3416.label: Leviticus 23:14
3416.text: You must not eat any bread, roasted grain, or new grain until this day, until you bring the offering of your God. It is a lasting statute for all your generations wherever you dwell.

3417.label: Leviticus 23:15
3417.text: “‘You are to count seven sabbaths from the day after the Sabbath, from the day that you bring the sheaf of the wave offering. They should be complete weeks.

3418.label: Leviticus 23:16
3418.text: You will count off 50 days until the day after the seventh Sabbath, and then you should present a new grain offering to Jehovah.

3419.label: Leviticus 23:17
3419.text: You should bring from your dwelling places two loaves as a wave offering. These should be made of two tenths of an eʹphah of fine flour. They should be baked with leaven, as first ripe fruits to Jehovah.

3420.label: Leviticus 23:18
3420.text: And you should present along with the loaves seven sound male lambs, each a year old, and one young bull and two rams. They will serve as a burnt offering to Jehovah along with the corresponding grain offering and drink offerings, as an offering made by fire, of a pleasing aroma to Jehovah.

3421.label: Leviticus 23:19
3421.text: And you must offer one young goat as a sin offering and two male lambs, each a year old, as a communion sacrifice.

3422.label: Leviticus 23:20
3422.text: The priest will wave them back and forth along with the loaves of the first ripe fruits, as a wave offering before Jehovah, together with the two male lambs. They should serve as something holy to Jehovah for the priest.

3423.label: Leviticus 23:21
3423.text: On this day you will make a proclamation for a holy convention for yourselves. You may not do any hard work. It is a lasting statute in all your dwelling places for all your generations.

3424.label: Leviticus 23:22
3424.text: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you must not reap the edge of your field completely and you should not pick up what is left from your harvest. You should leave it for the poor and for the foreign resident. I am Jehovah your God.’”

3425.label: Leviticus 23:23
3425.text: Jehovah went on speaking to Moses, saying:

3426.label: Leviticus 23:24
3426.text: “Tell the Israelites, ‘In the seventh month, on the first of the month, you should observe a complete rest, a memorial signaled by a trumpet blast, a holy convention.

3427.label: Leviticus 23:25
3427.text: You may not do any hard work, and you will present an offering made by fire to Jehovah.’”

3428.label: Leviticus 23:26
3428.text: Jehovah spoke further to Moses, saying:

3429.label: Leviticus 23:27
3429.text: “However, on the tenth of this seventh month is the Day of Atonement. You should observe a holy convention, and you must afflict yourselves and present an offering made by fire to Jehovah.

3430.label: Leviticus 23:28
3430.text: You are not to do any sort of work on this particular day because it is a day of atonement to make atonement for you before Jehovah your God.

3431.label: Leviticus 23:29
3431.text: Anyone who will not afflict himself on this day will be cut off from his people.

3432.label: Leviticus 23:30
3432.text: And I will destroy from among his people every person who does any sort of work on this day.

3433.label: Leviticus 23:31
3433.text: You must not do any sort of work. It is a lasting statute for all your generations wherever you dwell.

3434.label: Leviticus 23:32
3434.text: It is a sabbath of complete rest for you, and you will afflict yourselves on the ninth of the month in the evening. You should observe your sabbath from evening to evening.”

3435.label: Leviticus 23:33
3435.text: Jehovah continued speaking to Moses, saying:

3436.label: Leviticus 23:34
3436.text: “Tell the Israelites, ‘On the 15th day of this seventh month is the Festival of Booths for seven days to Jehovah.

3437.label: Leviticus 23:35
3437.text: There is to be a holy convention on the first day, and you should not do any hard work.

3438.label: Leviticus 23:36
3438.text: Seven days you must present an offering made by fire to Jehovah. On the eighth day, you should observe a holy convention, and you should present an offering made by fire to Jehovah. It is a solemn assembly. You may not do any hard work.

3439.label: Leviticus 23:37
3439.text: “‘These are the seasonal festivals of Jehovah that you should proclaim as holy conventions for presenting an offering made by fire to Jehovah: the burnt offering and the grain offering of the sacrifice and the drink offerings according to the daily schedule.

3440.label: Leviticus 23:38
3440.text: These are in addition to what is offered on Jehovah’s sabbaths, and your gifts, your vow offerings, and your voluntary offerings, which you should give to Jehovah.

3441.label: Leviticus 23:39
3441.text: However, on the 15th day of the seventh month, when you have gathered the produce of the land, you should celebrate the festival of Jehovah for seven days. On the first day is a complete rest and on the eighth day is a complete rest.

3442.label: Leviticus 23:40
3442.text: On the first day, you will take the fruit of majestic trees, the fronds of palm trees, the branches of leafy trees and poplars of the valley, and you will rejoice before Jehovah your God for seven days.

3443.label: Leviticus 23:41
3443.text: You will celebrate it as a festival to Jehovah for seven days in the year. As a lasting statute during all your generations, you should celebrate it in the seventh month.

3444.label: Leviticus 23:42
3444.text: You should dwell in the booths for seven days. All the natives in Israel should dwell in the booths,

3445.label: Leviticus 23:43
3445.text: so that your future generations may know that it was in the booths that I made the Israelites dwell when I was bringing them out of the land of Egypt. I am Jehovah your God.’”

3446.label: Leviticus 23:44
3446.text: So Moses spoke of the seasonal festivals of Jehovah to the Israelites.

3447.label: Leviticus 24:1
3447.text: Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

3448.label: Leviticus 24:2
3448.text: “Command the Israelites to bring to you pure, beaten olive oil for the lights, to keep the lamps lit constantly.

3449.label: Leviticus 24:3
3449.text: Outside the curtain of the Testimony in the tent of meeting, Aaron should arrange to keep the lamps lit from evening to morning before Jehovah constantly. It is a permanent statute for all your generations.

3450.label: Leviticus 24:4
3450.text: He should set the lamps in order on the lampstand of pure gold before Jehovah constantly.

3451.label: Leviticus 24:5
3451.text: “You will take fine flour and bake it into 12 ring-shaped loaves. Two tenths of an eʹphah should go into each loaf.

3452.label: Leviticus 24:6
3452.text: You will place them in two sets of layers, six to the layer set, on the table of pure gold before Jehovah.

3453.label: Leviticus 24:7
3453.text: You should put pure frankincense on each layer set, and it will serve as the bread for a token offering made by fire to Jehovah.

3454.label: Leviticus 24:8
3454.text: On each Sabbath day, he should regularly arrange it before Jehovah. It is a lasting covenant with the Israelites.

3455.label: Leviticus 24:9
3455.text: It will become Aaron’s and his sons’, and they will eat it in a holy place, because it is something most holy for him from Jehovah’s offerings made by fire, as a lasting regulation.”

3456.label: Leviticus 24:10
3456.text: Now among the Israelites was a son of an Israelite woman and an Egyptian man, and a fight broke out between him and an Israelite man in the camp.

3457.label: Leviticus 24:11
3457.text: The son of the Israelite woman began to abuse the Name and to curse it. So they brought him to Moses. Incidentally, his mother was She·loʹmith, the daughter of Dibʹri of the tribe of Dan.

3458.label: Leviticus 24:12
3458.text: They placed him in custody until Jehovah’s decision was made clear to them.

3460.label: Leviticus 24:14
3460.text: “Bring the one who cursed to the outside of the camp, and all those who heard him must lay their hands on his head, and then the entire assembly must stone him.

3461.label: Leviticus 24:15
3461.text: And you should tell the Israelites, ‘If any man curses his God, he will answer for his sin.

3462.label: Leviticus 24:16
3462.text: So the abuser of Jehovah’s name should be put to death without fail. The entire assembly should stone him without fail. The foreign resident should be put to death the same as the native for his abusing the Name.

3463.label: Leviticus 24:17
3463.text: “‘If a man takes a human life, he should be put to death without fail.

3464.label: Leviticus 24:18
3464.text: Anyone who strikes and kills a domestic animal should make compensation for it, life for life.

3465.label: Leviticus 24:19
3465.text: If a man injures his fellow man, then what he has done should be done to him.

3466.label: Leviticus 24:20
3466.text: Fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, the same sort of injury he inflicted should be inflicted on him.

3467.label: Leviticus 24:21
3467.text: The man who strikes and kills an animal should make compensation for it, but the one who strikes and kills a man should be put to death.

3468.label: Leviticus 24:22
3468.text: “‘One judicial decision will apply for you, whether a foreign resident or a native, because I am Jehovah your God.’”

3469.label: Leviticus 24:23
3469.text: Moses then spoke to the Israelites, and they brought the one who uttered the curse to the outside of the camp, and they stoned him. Thus the Israelites did just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

3470.label: Leviticus 25:1
3470.text: Jehovah spoke further to Moses on Mount Siʹnai, saying:

3471.label: Leviticus 25:2
3471.text: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them, ‘When you eventually come into the land that I am giving you, then the land will observe a sabbath to Jehovah.

3472.label: Leviticus 25:3
3472.text: Six years you should sow your field with seed, and six years you should prune your vineyard, and you will gather the land’s produce.

3473.label: Leviticus 25:4
3473.text: But in the seventh year, there should be a sabbath of complete rest for the land, a sabbath to Jehovah. You should not sow your field with seed or prune your vineyard.

3474.label: Leviticus 25:5
3474.text: You must not reap what grows on its own from the grain left after the harvest, and the grapes of your unpruned vine you must not gather. There should be a year of complete rest for the land.

3475.label: Leviticus 25:6
3475.text: However, you may eat the food that grows in the land during its sabbath; you, your male and female slaves, your hired worker, and the foreign settlers who are residing with you may eat it,

3476.label: Leviticus 25:7
3476.text: as well as the domestic and the wild animals in your land. Everything the land produces may be eaten.

3477.label: Leviticus 25:8
3477.text: “‘You will count off seven sabbath years, seven times seven years, and the days of the seven sabbath years will amount to 49 years.

3478.label: Leviticus 25:9
3478.text: You will then sound the horn loudly in the seventh month, on the tenth of the month; on the Day of Atonement, you should cause the sound of the horn to be heard in all your land.

3479.label: Leviticus 25:10
3479.text: You must sanctify the 50th year and proclaim liberty in the land to all its inhabitants. It will become a Jubilee for you, and each of you will return to his property and each of you should return to his family.

3480.label: Leviticus 25:11
3480.text: A Jubilee is what that 50th year will become for you. You will not sow seed or reap what grew on its own from leftover grain nor gather the grapes of unpruned vines.

3481.label: Leviticus 25:12
3481.text: For it is a Jubilee. It is to be holy to you. You may eat only what the land produces by itself.

3482.label: Leviticus 25:13
3482.text: “‘In this year of the Jubilee, each of you should return to his property.

3483.label: Leviticus 25:14
3483.text: If you sell anything to your fellow man or if you buy from him, do not exploit one another.

3484.label: Leviticus 25:15
3484.text: You should buy from your fellow man, taking into account the number of the years after the Jubilee, and he should sell to you according to the remaining years for crops.

3485.label: Leviticus 25:16
3485.text: If there are many years remaining, he may increase its purchase price, and when there are few years left, he should reduce its purchase price, because he is selling you the number of crops to be produced.

3486.label: Leviticus 25:17
3486.text: No one among you should exploit his fellow man, and you must be in fear of your God, for I am Jehovah your God.

3487.label: Leviticus 25:18
3487.text: By your carrying out my statutes and keeping my judicial decisions, you will dwell in security in the land.

3488.label: Leviticus 25:19
3488.text: The land will give its fruitage, and you will eat to satisfaction and dwell there in security.

3489.label: Leviticus 25:20
3489.text: “‘But if you should say: “What will we eat in the seventh year if we may not sow seed or gather our crops?”

3490.label: Leviticus 25:21
3490.text: I will command my blessing for you in the sixth year, and the land will yield a crop sufficient for three years.

3491.label: Leviticus 25:22
3491.text: Then you will sow seed in the eighth year and eat from the old crop until the ninth year. Until its crop arrives, you will eat from the old.

3492.label: Leviticus 25:23
3492.text: “‘The land should not be sold on a permanent basis, because the land is mine. For you are foreign residents and settlers from my standpoint.

3493.label: Leviticus 25:24
3493.text: Throughout the land of your possession, you should grant the right of buying back the land.

3494.label: Leviticus 25:25
3494.text: “‘If your brother becomes poor and has to sell some of his property, a repurchaser who is closely related to him must come and buy back what his brother sold.

3495.label: Leviticus 25:26
3495.text: If anyone has no repurchaser but he becomes prosperous and finds the means to repurchase it,

3496.label: Leviticus 25:27
3496.text: he should calculate its value for the years since he sold it and refund the difference to the man whom he sold it to. Then he may return to his property.

3497.label: Leviticus 25:28
3497.text: “‘But if he does not find the means to get it back from him, what he sold will remain with the purchaser until the Jubilee year; and it will revert to him in the Jubilee, and he will return to his property.

3498.label: Leviticus 25:29
3498.text: “‘Now if a man should sell a home in a walled city, his right of repurchase will also continue until the end of the year from the time of his completing the sale; his right of repurchase will be valid a whole year.

3499.label: Leviticus 25:30
3499.text: But if it is not bought back by the end of one full year, the house within the walled city will become the permanent property of its purchaser throughout his generations. It should not be released in the Jubilee.

3500.label: Leviticus 25:31
3500.text: However, the houses of settlements with no surrounding wall should be considered to be part of the field of the countryside. The right of repurchase should continue for it, and it should be released in the Jubilee.

3501.label: Leviticus 25:32
3501.text: “‘As for the houses of the Levites within their cities, the Levites will have the permanent right to repurchase them.

3502.label: Leviticus 25:33
3502.text: When the property of the Levites is not bought back, the house sold in the city belonging to them will also be released in the Jubilee, because the houses of the cities of the Levites are their property among the Israelites.

3503.label: Leviticus 25:34
3503.text: Moreover, the field of pasture ground surrounding their cities may not be sold, for it is their permanent possession.

3504.label: Leviticus 25:35
3504.text: “‘If your brother who is nearby becomes poor and cannot support himself, you must sustain him as you would a foreign resident and a settler, so that he may keep alive with you.

3505.label: Leviticus 25:36
3505.text: Do not take interest or make a profit from him. You must be in fear of your God, and your brother will keep alive with you.

3506.label: Leviticus 25:37
3506.text: You must not lend him your money on interest or give out your food for profit.

3507.label: Leviticus 25:38
3507.text: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to give you the land of Caʹnaan, to prove myself your God.

3508.label: Leviticus 25:39
3508.text: “‘If your brother who lives nearby becomes poor and he has to sell himself to you, you must not force him to do slave labor.

3509.label: Leviticus 25:40
3509.text: He should be treated like a hired worker, like a settler. He should serve with you until the Jubilee year.

3510.label: Leviticus 25:41
3510.text: Then he will leave you, he and his children with him, and return to his family. He should return to the property of his forefathers.

3511.label: Leviticus 25:42
3511.text: For they are my slaves whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They should not sell themselves the way a slave is sold.

3512.label: Leviticus 25:43
3512.text: You must not treat him cruelly, and you must be in fear of your God.

3513.label: Leviticus 25:44
3513.text: Your male and female slaves are to come from the nations around you, from them you may buy a male or a female slave.

3514.label: Leviticus 25:45
3514.text: Also from the sons of the foreign settlers who are residing with you, from them and from their families that are born to them in your land you may buy slaves, and they will become your possession.

3515.label: Leviticus 25:46
3515.text: You may pass them on as an inheritance to your sons after you to inherit as a permanent possession. You may use them as workers, but you must not subject your Israelite brothers to cruel treatment.

3516.label: Leviticus 25:47
3516.text: “‘But if a foreign resident or a settler among you becomes wealthy and your brother has become poor alongside him and must sell himself to the foreign resident or the settler who lives among you, or to a member of the family of the foreign resident,

3517.label: Leviticus 25:48
3517.text: he will continue to have the right of repurchase after he has sold himself. One of his brothers may buy him back,

3518.label: Leviticus 25:49
3518.text: or his uncle or the son of his uncle may buy him back, or any close relative, one of his family, may buy him back. “‘Or if he himself has become wealthy, he may also buy himself back.

3519.label: Leviticus 25:50
3519.text: He should calculate with his purchaser the time from the year he sold himself to him until the Jubilee year, and the money of his sale will correspond to the number of years. His workdays during that time will be assessed at the rate of a hired worker.

3520.label: Leviticus 25:51
3520.text: If there are many years remaining, he should pay his repurchase price in proportion to the years that are left.

3521.label: Leviticus 25:52
3521.text: But if only a few years remain until the Jubilee year, he should then calculate for himself and pay his repurchase price in proportion to the years remaining.

3522.label: Leviticus 25:53
3522.text: He should continue to serve him year by year as a hired worker; and you should see to it that he does not treat him cruelly.

3523.label: Leviticus 25:54
3523.text: However, if he cannot buy himself back on these terms, he will then go free in the year of Jubilee, he and his children with him.

3524.label: Leviticus 25:55
3524.text: “‘For the Israelites are my own slaves. They are my slaves whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am Jehovah your God.

3525.label: Leviticus 26:1
3525.text: “‘You must not make worthless gods for yourselves, and you must not set up a carved image or a sacred pillar for yourselves, and you must not put a stone figure in your land in order to bow down toward it; for I am Jehovah your God.

3526.label: Leviticus 26:2
3526.text: You should keep my sabbaths and show reverence for my sanctuary. I am Jehovah.

3527.label: Leviticus 26:3
3527.text: “‘If you continue walking in my statutes and keeping my commandments and you carry them out,

3528.label: Leviticus 26:4
3528.text: I will give you showers of rain at their proper time, and the land will yield its produce, and the trees of the field will give their fruit.

3529.label: Leviticus 26:5
3529.text: Your threshing season will extend until your grape harvest, and the grape harvest will extend until the sowing season; and you will eat your bread to satisfaction and dwell in security in your land.

3530.label: Leviticus 26:6
3530.text: I will put peace in the land, and you will lie down with no one making you afraid; and I will rid the land of vicious wild animals, and a sword of war will not pass through your land.

3531.label: Leviticus 26:7
3531.text: You will certainly pursue your enemies, and they will fall before you by the sword.

3532.label: Leviticus 26:8
3532.text: Five of you will pursue 100, and 100 of you will pursue 10,000, and your enemies will fall before you by the sword.

3533.label: Leviticus 26:9
3533.text: “‘I will direct my favor to you and make you fruitful and multiply you, and I will keep my covenant with you.

3534.label: Leviticus 26:10
3534.text: While you are still eating the old produce of the preceding year, you will need to clear out the old to make way for the new.

3535.label: Leviticus 26:11
3535.text: And I will place my tabernacle in your midst, and I will not reject you.

3536.label: Leviticus 26:12
3536.text: I will walk among you and be your God, and you for your part will be my people.

3537.label: Leviticus 26:13
3537.text: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be their slaves no longer, and I broke the bars of your yoke and made you walk with heads held high.

3538.label: Leviticus 26:14
3538.text: “‘However, if you will not listen to me or keep all these commandments,

3539.label: Leviticus 26:15
3539.text: and if you reject my statutes, and if you abhor my judicial decisions so that you do not keep all my commandments, and you violate my covenant,

3540.label: Leviticus 26:16
3540.text: I, for my part, will do the following to you: I will punish you with distress, with tuberculosis and burning fever, making your eyes fail and your life waste away. You will sow your seed simply for nothing, for your enemies will eat it.

3541.label: Leviticus 26:17
3541.text: I will set my face against you, and you will be defeated by your enemies; and those who hate you will tread on you, and you will flee when no one is pursuing you.

3542.label: Leviticus 26:18
3542.text: “‘If even this does not make you listen to me, I will have to chastise you seven times as much for your sins.

3543.label: Leviticus 26:19
3543.text: I will break your stubborn pride and make your heavens like iron and your earth like copper.

3544.label: Leviticus 26:20
3544.text: You will exhaust your strength for nothing, as your land will not yield its produce, and the trees of the land will not produce fruit.

3545.label: Leviticus 26:21
3545.text: “‘But if you keep walking in opposition to me and refuse to listen to me, I will then have to strike you seven times as much, according to your sins.

3546.label: Leviticus 26:22
3546.text: I will send the wild animals of the field among you, and they will bereave you of children and annihilate your domestic animals and reduce your numbers, and your roads will be deserted.

3547.label: Leviticus 26:23
3547.text: “‘If in spite of these things you do not accept my correction and you insist on walking in opposition to me,

3548.label: Leviticus 26:24
3548.text: then I too will walk in opposition to you, and I myself will strike you seven times for your sins.

3549.label: Leviticus 26:25
3549.text: I will bring an avenging sword upon you for breaking the covenant. If you gather yourselves into your cities, I will send disease into your midst, and you will be given into the hand of an enemy.

3550.label: Leviticus 26:26
3550.text: When I destroy your supply of bread, ten women will be able to bake your bread in only one oven and then ration your bread by weight; and you will eat but you will not be satisfied.

3551.label: Leviticus 26:27
3551.text: “‘If in spite of this you will not listen to me and you insist on walking in opposition to me,

3552.label: Leviticus 26:28
3552.text: I will intensify my opposition to you, and I myself will have to chastise you seven times for your sins.

3553.label: Leviticus 26:29
3553.text: So you will have to eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.

3554.label: Leviticus 26:30
3554.text: I will annihilate your sacred high places and cut down your incense stands and pile your carcasses on the carcasses of your disgusting idols, and I will turn away from you in disgust.

3555.label: Leviticus 26:31
3555.text: I will give your cities to the sword and make your sanctuaries desolate, and I will not smell the pleasing aromas of your sacrifices.

3556.label: Leviticus 26:32
3556.text: I myself will make the land desolate, and your enemies who are dwelling in it will stare in amazement over it.

3557.label: Leviticus 26:33
3557.text: And I will scatter you among the nations, and I will unsheathe a sword after you; and your land will be made desolate, and your cities will be devastated.

3558.label: Leviticus 26:34
3558.text: “‘At that time the land will pay off its sabbaths all the days it lies desolate, while you are in the land of your enemies. At that time the land will rest, as it must repay its sabbaths.

3559.label: Leviticus 26:35
3559.text: All the days it lies desolate it will rest, because it did not rest during your sabbaths when you were dwelling on it.

3560.label: Leviticus 26:36
3560.text: “‘As for those who survive, I will fill their hearts with despair in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a blowing leaf will cause them to flee, and they will flee like someone running from the sword and fall without anyone pursuing them.

3561.label: Leviticus 26:37
3561.text: They will stumble over one another like those running from a sword, though no one is pursuing them. You will not be able to resist your enemies.

3562.label: Leviticus 26:38
3562.text: You will perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies will consume you.

3563.label: Leviticus 26:39
3563.text: Those of you who remain will be left to rot in the lands of your enemies because of your error. Yes, they will rot away because of the errors of their fathers.

3564.label: Leviticus 26:40
3564.text: Then they will confess their own error and the error and unfaithfulness of their fathers and admit that they behaved unfaithfully by walking in opposition to me.

3565.label: Leviticus 26:41
3565.text: Then I also walked in opposition to them by bringing them into the land of their enemies. “‘Perhaps then their uncircumcised heart will be humbled, and then they will pay off their error.

3566.label: Leviticus 26:42
3566.text: And I will remember my covenant with Jacob, and my covenant with Isaac, and I will remember my covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.

3567.label: Leviticus 26:43
3567.text: While the land was abandoned by them, it was paying off its sabbaths and lying desolate without them, and they were paying for their error, because they rejected my judicial decisions and they abhorred my statutes.

3568.label: Leviticus 26:44
3568.text: But despite all of this, while they are in the land of their enemies, I will never completely reject them nor cast them away to the point of exterminating them, which would violate my covenant with them, for I am Jehovah their God.

3569.label: Leviticus 26:45
3569.text: For their sakes I will remember the covenant with their ancestors whom I brought out of the land of Egypt under the eyes of the nations, in order to prove myself their God. I am Jehovah.’”

3570.label: Leviticus 26:46
3570.text: These are the regulations, the judicial decisions, and the laws that Jehovah established between himself and the Israelites on Mount Siʹnai through Moses.

3571.label: Leviticus 27:1
3571.text: Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

3572.label: Leviticus 27:2
3572.text: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them, ‘If a man makes a special vow to offer the estimated value of a person to Jehovah,

3573.label: Leviticus 27:3
3573.text: the estimated value of a male from 20 to 60 years old will be 50 shekels of silver by the standard shekel of the holy place.

3574.label: Leviticus 27:4
3574.text: But if it is a female, the estimated value will be 30 shekels.

3575.label: Leviticus 27:5
3575.text: If the age is from 5 to 20 years old, the estimated value of the male will be 20 shekels and 10 shekels for the female.

3576.label: Leviticus 27:6
3576.text: If the age is from one month up to five years old, the estimated value of the male will be five shekels of silver and three shekels of silver for the female.

3577.label: Leviticus 27:7
3577.text: “‘If the age is 60 years and over, the estimated value will be 15 shekels for the male and 10 shekels for the female.

3578.label: Leviticus 27:8
3578.text: But if he is too poor to pay the estimated value, the person will stand before the priest, and the priest will set a value on him. The priest will make the valuation according to what the one making the vow can afford.

3579.label: Leviticus 27:9
3579.text: “‘If the vow involves an animal that is suitable for offering to Jehovah, whatever may be given to Jehovah will become something holy.

3580.label: Leviticus 27:10
3580.text: He may not replace it or exchange it with good for bad or with bad for good. But if he should exchange it with one animal for another animal, the original and what is exchanged for it will both become holy.

3581.label: Leviticus 27:11
3581.text: If it is an unclean animal that may not be presented as an offering to Jehovah, he will then stand the animal before the priest.

3582.label: Leviticus 27:12
3582.text: The priest will then set its value, as to whether it is good or bad. The value estimated by the priest will stand.

3583.label: Leviticus 27:13
3583.text: But if he ever wants to buy it back, he must then give a fifth of it in addition to the estimated value.

3584.label: Leviticus 27:14
3584.text: “‘Now if a man should sanctify his house as something holy to Jehovah, the priest will then set its value, whether it is good or bad. According to the value that the priest sets, that is what it will cost.

3585.label: Leviticus 27:15
3585.text: But if the one who sanctifies his house wants to buy it back, he must then give a fifth of the money of the estimated value in addition to it, and it will become his.

3586.label: Leviticus 27:16
3586.text: “‘If a man sanctifies to Jehovah some of the field that he possesses, the value will be estimated in proportion to the seed needed to sow it: a hoʹmer of barley seed will be 50 shekels of silver.

3587.label: Leviticus 27:17
3587.text: If he sanctifies his field from the year of Jubilee, the estimated value stands.

3588.label: Leviticus 27:18
3588.text: If he sanctifies his field after the Jubilee, the priest will calculate for him the price in proportion to the years that are left until the next year of Jubilee, and a deduction should be made from the estimated value.

3589.label: Leviticus 27:19
3589.text: But if the one who sanctified it should ever buy the field back, he must then give a fifth of the money of the estimated value in addition to it, and it will remain his.

3590.label: Leviticus 27:20
3590.text: Now if he should not buy the field back and the field is sold to another man, it may not be bought back again.

3591.label: Leviticus 27:21
3591.text: When the field is released in the Jubilee, it will become something holy to Jehovah, as a field that is devoted to him. It will become the property of the priests.

3592.label: Leviticus 27:22
3592.text: “‘If a man sanctifies to Jehovah a field he purchased that is not part of his hereditary property,

3593.label: Leviticus 27:23
3593.text: the priest will calculate for him the amount of the valuation up until the year of Jubilee, and he will give the estimated value on that day. It is something holy to Jehovah.

3594.label: Leviticus 27:24
3594.text: In the year of Jubilee, the field will return to the one he bought it from, to the one the land belongs to.

3595.label: Leviticus 27:25
3595.text: “‘Every value should be estimated by the standard shekel of the holy place. The shekel should amount to 20 geʹrahs.

3596.label: Leviticus 27:26
3596.text: “‘However, no one should sanctify the firstborn of the animals, since it is born as the firstborn for Jehovah. Whether bull or sheep, it already belongs to Jehovah.

3597.label: Leviticus 27:27
3597.text: If it is among the unclean animals and he redeems it according to the estimated value, he should give a fifth of it in addition to it. But if it is not bought back, it will be sold according to the estimated value.

3598.label: Leviticus 27:28
3598.text: “‘But no devoted thing that a man devotes unconditionally to Jehovah from his belongings may be sold or bought back, whether from mankind or animals or the field he possesses. Every devoted thing is something most holy to Jehovah.

3599.label: Leviticus 27:29
3599.text: Furthermore, no condemned person who is set apart for destruction may be redeemed. He should be put to death without fail.

3600.label: Leviticus 27:30
3600.text: “‘Every tenth part of the land, whether from the produce of the field or the fruit of the trees, belongs to Jehovah. It is something holy to Jehovah.

3601.label: Leviticus 27:31
3601.text: If a man ever wants to buy any of his tenth part back, he should give a fifth of it in addition to it.

3602.label: Leviticus 27:32
3602.text: As for every tenth part of the herd and flock, everything that passes under the shepherd’s staff, the tenth animal should become something holy to Jehovah.

3603.label: Leviticus 27:33
3603.text: He should not examine whether it is good or bad, neither should he exchange it. But if he would ever try to exchange it, both the original and what is exchanged for it should become something holy. It may not be bought back.’”

3604.label: Leviticus 27:34
3604.text: These are the commandments that Jehovah gave to Moses for the Israelites on Mount Siʹnai.
